This was easy and good. I chose mozzarella and didn't use mushrooms.

I was really excited to try this based on the reviews and ingredients but family and I were disappointed. It was very bland. I used italian pork sausage and mozzarella cheese - I think I will try one more time but use cheddar cheese and a spicier pork sausage.

VERY good recipe even though I used the Pillsbury type pizza dough by mistake. I was skeert the filling would break thru but it didn't. Left out the 'shrooms so the kids would eat it. It was good enough to where they now ask for it regulary but I will use bread dough instead.
Very good and easy!  Similar to a stromboli recipe that I make often "Recipe #211974".  I used cheddar cheese and did not add mushrooms.  Thanks for a keeper...

This was pretty good. Used a leftover sundried tomato italian sausage linked that I chopped up small that I added to 1 caramelized onion. Used 3 frozen dough rolls. Everything came along easy and good except I forgot to add the cheddar, so had to unroll everything! lol.

WOW is this GOOD! I messed up when I was making mine and had to smash it back together because I didn't read that I had to transfer to a cookie sheet before assembling. Therefore it fell apart in transfer. I pushed it back together into a mess. came out of the oven and Was GREAT! We dipped it in Marinara sauce!!
This is a GREAT recipe-so easy and delicious!!  My BF and I ended up eating 1/2 the loaf for dinner the other night with some maranara and a salad...I'll definately be making this again and again!
We LOVED it!  We added some hot pepper flakes on the inside and garlic salt on the outside.

Very yummy.  I used fresh dough I made in the bread machine and only needed 1/2 pound of sausage.  It is wonderful sausage cheese bread!  I am giving some to my mommy and MIL for mothers day.  Hope I don't eat it all first.  I used a mexican 4 cheese blend for the cheese.  Thanks for sharing!

If you are looking for some nice spicy wings ~ try this recipe!  They were a little too spicy for me (but I ate them anyway, LOL) and DH wanted them a little spicier and DS said they were just right.  Very easy to make with excellent flavor.  Very much like traditional buffalo wings but much easier.  Thanks for posting a keeper!

I LOVE THIS RECIPE!  Great combo of flavors.  I will be adding a little cayenne next time to kick the heat up.  I grilled them and had to keep a good eye on them to keep the honey from burning but that was not big deal.  Thanks for a great recipe.
My dh absolutely loved these wings! They were so flavorful and good.  I have to say that they were very tasty.  Thanks so much for sharing!

This is my kind of spicy wings.  I did cut the recipe back to a dozrn wings, no problem Also cut back a bit on the honey & butter but used all the hot sauce(Denzil's Peachs 'n Scream)  This is one tasty recipe that is going right into my favorites Thanks Marie for posting

Really tasty wings! I was leary of the honey making them too sweet, but that's not the case. I followed the recipe exactly, and they came out perfect.  The flavors melded together very well. Great recipe.
I am giving this 5 stars because my boyfriend said these were the best wings he has ever had. Very easy.
I thought these were just so-so.  They were more like bbq chicken than hot wings, barely any heat at all.  We did eat them, liked the flavor, but not the wing taste we were looking for.
Tasty - but not nearly as hot or spicy as most "buffalo" wing recipies.

This recipe got 5*'s out of my "testers".  I made this as you directed and the results were very, very good.  I used Gebhart's  chili powder and Cajun Chef hot sauce.  Nice meld of flavors and not so hot that the kids couldn't eat them.  I suggest that if you want these hotter, make a hot dip to dip them in.  Thanks for sharing your recipe, Marie.

These were very tasty -- but I was expecting them to be a little spicier.  I will definitely make them again -- but I'll add more hot sauce and as one other reviewer suggested, some cayenne pepper. I also found that they didn't need the 1 1/4 hours baking time.  It turned out to be under an hour.  The next time I make them, I will also watch them a little closer in the oven -- they got a little dark by the first time I was ready to turn them.  Consequently, I'll also lower the temperature to 365 instead of 375.   After that first batch, I used the non-stick aluminum foil and that worked great.

I have already made these twice. I didn't add the total amount listed for the chili powder or hot sauce so it wouldn't be too spicy for the kids and they were still yummy. I love the sweetness of the honey with the tang of the hot sauce. 
I also agree with others that they didn't need to bake for the whole time listed, 45 min to an hour depending on your over is fine. 
Already planning on making these again. Thanks for posting Marie!!

I cooked our wings at 350 for 1 hour and they came out perfectly glazed and brown and delicious.  I turned down the heat on ours and only used 1 tsp. chili powder and less hot pepper sauce, about 1/2 as much.  Al Roker, you rock..  These wings are GREAT!  Thanks!

I used Frank's Hot Sauce and it worked fine.  We loved the wings and had them when friends were over so they could help me rate them!  We all give them thumbs up, so you know they will be made here again!  We all loved the hot/sweet combination of flavors!  We had them with rice and peas with mushrooms.  It was a very nice dinner if I do say so myself!  Thanks!
Maybe it was just us, but we didn't find these spicy at all.  I was trying 3 different wing recipes and these were our least favorite.  They are "ok", but for us they just had too little flavor.

I doubled this recipe and that fed 4 hungry adults. The shrimp were very good. The lime flavor enhanced that of the shrimp and made it very zingy. A yummy grilling recipe that we will use again. Thanks.

I increased the amounts in this recipe because I had 4 lb. of fresh shrimp to use. The marinade was very good we thought. You could taste the lime but the cumin was what gave it kick. I wouldn't go by the servings listed because 6 people ate 4 lb. of shrimp. Guess it just depends on how hungry you are   ;) Great grilled shrimp.
Very tasty.  The pepper gave this shrimp a bit of a kick.  Next time I'll try reducing the amount of salt to 1/2 tsp.

I loved this recipe.  I added a bit more lime zest and juice than called for because I love the citrus flavor and it really made the taste zing.  Next time I'll probably reduce the amount of salt by half and add a bit more cumin for a spicy kick.  I will make this one again.

Outrageously good. This will be a great one for entertaining because it can be made ahead and not a lot of last minute fuss. I added a tch of hot sauce and -- as the weather was poor -- broiled it in the oven.

This was absolutly delicious! We loved this recipe. I made it for the 4th of July along with some scallops, corn on the cob, rice and a lemon cake. These little things were very succulent. I will be using this recipe again and again. Thank you so much. You always seem to have such good recipes.
These were fabulous! Everybody in the family agreed that these were the best shrimp we've ever had. The only change I'll make is to reduce the salt next time. Thanks for posting!
Oh! So good. I split the shrimp and stuffed with the marinade and squeezed lime over it.

Experienced transcedent seafood tastebud bliss.  And this with frying the shrimp up in a pan instead of grilling them.  Used 1/4 tsp. cumin and 1/4-1/2 tsp. salt.  Shrimp had just the right bite with subtle tones from the lime, garlic and cumin.  The oregano, salt and pepper helped blend the flavors.  We served them with homemade fried rice and vegetables. This recipe is definitely a keeper.

what a delicious dish! I love how the spices and lime mingle with each other - it's simply fantastic. Definitely use fresh lime for this. I used large tiger prawns and grilled them in the oven for 8 minutes, and they were perfect. I served this with garlic bread and minestrone. Yummy! Thanks NurseDi.

I followed the recipe on ingredients but didn't actually measure them but must have done something right, they turned out perfect.  I cooked them on the rack in my turbo oven for exactly 5 mins and had them with a mixed salad.  This will be a favourite, as it is tasty and healthy as well.
Fabulous recipe - very quick, easy and healthy! We cooked them on the BBQ and served with a salad - yum. Thanks NurseDi!

Oh wow!  This was so good.  I added a bit more lime juice and garlic than the recipe called for just because I like both.  Not that they needed it, but I dipped the shrimp in Caesar dressing which was a nice complement.  This recipe is definitely a keeper.
this is definately a recipe i will be making again! i doubled it and added scallops as well. great flavor and very tropical! enjoyed it on our patio this evening listening to jimmy buffett. thanks!
I made this last night and it was delicious. Very quick and easy to make.  Thanks for sharing.

Most excellent shrimp!!  I didn't have any cumin so we did without and the shrimp were still great.  Passed this recipe on to my Mom since we liked it so much.  Will be making it over and over this summer on the grill.  Thanks for sharing!

I cannot even begin to tell you how much my husband and I enjoyed this recipe.  There was just enough flavor with the cumin, and oh, how I do love garlic. I served it with a side of corn and coconut muffins.  It is already on the menu for next week when we have company.  (I can't wait to have this dish again!) Thanks for an absolute winner.

I find skewered grilled shrimp to be a boring, but this recipe is just wonderful.  The marinade just wakens the flavor of grilled shrimp and leaves you wanting more.  I did omit the salt with good results.  Thank you NurseDi for sharing the recipe.

Great marinade, perfect flavor and bite.  I add some wet teabags to the coals of the grill to create more smoke and enhance the grill flavor.  I have made this a number of times now, and it always comes out great.
Excellent flavor! I didn't have a grill, so I had to sautee them, so the texture wasn't quite right. Next time, I will try a grilling pan.

This is a great treat!
Also used sea scallops with jumbo shrimp, yummy.
Thanks for the info.

I've already rated this recipe, but I wanted to add a comment. I prepared these shrimp for a family gathering. I started with cooked shrimp and just marinated them in the lime mixture for about 1 hours prior to the gathering. Don't leave them in the marinade for too long because the acid in the lime will cook them and make them tough. Everyone loved them! The cat even nabbed one before we noticed her on the table. LOL.

This recipe is delicious, easy and I've found it's tasty at any temperature. The shrimp has an amazingly intense flavor, inspite of short marinating time and ease of recipe.   An immediate hit, and favorite appetizer recipe. thank you!
Very simple with easy prep and outstanding results.  Followed instructions exactly.  Thanks Di.
This recipe was deliciously spiced.  This was definately a keeper.  Thank you!

I can't believe I haven't put in my rating, I have made this so many times!  This is truly one of my favorites, is a huge crowd pleaser, portable (I have even made camping, just brought the marinade in a ziploc bag) and so simple to make.
These were awesome!!  I wouldn't change a thing!!!
Very good. I doubled the recipe so I could coat the shrimp more often while grilling.
WOW! As a recipe junkie, this one is in my top 10 recipes ever!

Loved, Loved, Loved this! DH and I were trying to find a lime, garlic shrimp recipe that was similar to what we had on vacation. This recipe is right on. I made the marinade the day before to let the flavors really meld. Thank you for bringing a taste of the islands here to La.
yummy...thanks for a great recipe! Even my seafood hating son loved this!

Absolutely fantastic. I used 1/2 tsp. cumin, 1/2 tsp. salt, and 3 Tbsp. lime juice. I brought this to my sister's house for a cookout, and we did this first before the meat. Best shrimp on the grill I've ever had, by a long shot.

Very tasty! I used lemon instead of lime (didn't have any limes), 1/2 t garlic powder instead of garlic, and added a few sprinkles of chili powder. We made fajitas out of these.Perfect--thanks for the recipe!

Oh, my gosh... I thought I had reviewed this before, but I guess I spaced it! This is by far one of the best shrimp marinades out there! I have also used it for chicken breasts with yummy results. The only thing I did differently was to add finely chopped cilantro to the marinade, because I love the flavors of cumin, lime, and cilantro together. Perfection!
This was SO good!  I used this on precooked shrimp and they were perfect!
Very good.  I used them to top a great fried rice and the smoky lime flavor enhanced the entire dish.
We loved these little babies!  We had along with some Lemon Orzo. Excellent dish!
YUM!!!  The only thing I added was some habanero sauce.  Grilled it for about 5 mns and I think I could have ate 1 lb by myself!  Can't wait to go and buy more shrimp...Thanks a bunch!

This was delicious and so quick and easy!  I brushed the leftover marinade on the steaks I grilled to go along with the shrimp.  I would definitely use less salt next time, but thanks for the great recipe!

Made this for our housewarming cookout and everyone loved it, even my three year old! Our grocery store didn't have peeled, deveined shrimp (being lazy, I didn't want to do it myself) so I bought pre-skewered, frozen shrimp. They still turned out fantastic!

WOW are these great!!  The only thing I did not have on hand was cumin, but I did have some Mexene chili powder that has a strong cumin component.  I was very hestitant as your recipe called for nothing of the sort, but my shrimp was thawed and I had no choice.  They turned out way better than I could have hoped for.  Easy to whip up the marinade, easy to skewer up the shrimp, and an easy flip on the grill and your done!  The spices are definitely there but I was so pleased how they didn't completely overpower the shrimp.  You knew you were eating a very well-seasoned deliciously grilled shrimp!  I was glad that I made a double batch...otherwise we would have been crying the grilled lime shrimp blues!!  Fantastic on their own, but I can't help but wonder what they would be like as an add-in to a good homemade alfredo sauce over pasta!?!  Thanks for this GREAT recipe!  :)

My DD made this for us while my other DD was here and we were in shrimp heaven!  Wow, these had great flavors going on.  We all agreed it's a 5 starrer and it is now in a safe place waiting to be made again!
Wonderful tasting shrimp.  Loved the cumin in it.  Thanks for posting.

Oh my goodness was this ever good! Hubby and I both had seconds. Plus, I got compliments. I doubled the recipe because I hade 2 lbs. of shrimp. I had old limes, so lime zest wasn't possible. I used the larger portion of lime juice. I also used the corrugated back side of my stove-top griddle instead of the BBQ because it was cold, windy, and dark outside. That worked out great! I did not skewer them because they were very large shrimp, prawns actually, so turned them with tongs. They cooked so quickly, I couldn't baste them even once. That made no difference, as the spices were very present in the finished product. I can't even imagine how wonderful they would be cooked over charcoal, because I thought shrimp didn't get any better than this. Do not marinate too long. I almost overdid it waiting for my rice to finish cooking.  This goes into my "best of the best" notebook for sure!  We had these as the main course, but they would also be great appetizers.
This was delicious and very easy!  I used 1/2 teaspoon salt and cumin and 3 tablespoons lemon juice.  I don't have a grill, so I sauteed the shrimp.  They still came out perfect.

I love an easy but delicious recipe, and this one really delivered.  It was very flavorful, especially when cooked over the grill. I served with summer vegetables and wild rice. I will definitely be making this again!  Thanks!
Great dish that can be put together in no time, with ingredients I can usually find in my kitchen. This one is a keeper. Thank you.
Wonderful mixture, I added just a touch of cayenne for heat and used a 1/2 lb of scallops and a 1/2 pound of shrimp.  Served over a crunchy Thai style slaw, a beautiful summer dinner. Thanks

I followed the directions to a T.  Very easy and fast.  The shrimp came out nice and mild.  None of the flavors dominated.  I think next time I will serve these with fresh wedges of lime to be sqeeze onto the cooked shrimp because I love limes.  Thank you for an easy and delicious recipe.
Mmmmmm!  Followed ingredient directions, but cooked in a pan on the stove.  Served with black beans and cheese quesadillas.  Made 3 picky little boys very happy....

YUM!! I have LOVED shrimp since I was a baby - I used to sit on the back porch as a toddler and eat gulf shrimp boiled, with no sauce, as an afternoon snack!
I am always looking for more ways to cook and eat shrimp as I prepare it at least twice a week in my house. This is a FANTASTIC recipe and should be re-named "The best tasting, easiest summer shrimp recipe"!! 
Both my husband and I LOVED this shrimp, and between the two of us we ate the whole pound! We have since served it to friends at our dinner parties and everyone raves about it! 

My only changes were: 
I used a lot more garlic because we love garlic in my house, and also added lime zest as well as the juice - the zest adds even more flavor and is a little sweeter.

I am not a shrimp fan but when Precious Miracle came home from college and announced she now loves grilled shrimp I went looking for a recipe! This was a hands down winner - fast easy and the flavors had Mr. Wonderful asking for this to be a regular on our weekly menu - it had to be 5 stars. Best part it is so easy and fast.  I used Key Lime juice - and it was to die for. Thank you!
Nice marinade. We really enjoyed this. Thanks for the recipe.

This is a wonderful recipe! If you want a GREAT variation, substitute Paprika for the Cumin, and you have a delightful variation that you can serve over any type of rice you choose, simply awesome! Personally I like this variation with Wild and Long Grain rice, you can't go wrong!

Just tried this for dinner tonight and loved it! It's a keeper. By the end of the meal, we were already brainstorming what else might work with this marinade!  Not only did we enjoy the taste, but the marinade uses all ingredients that I tend to have on hand anyway, AND it doesn't take long to marinade the shrimp. Thanks for a great recipe!
Great.  Tossed the whole bowl of shrimp and marinade into a pan and sauteed.  VERY flavorful.
Delicious and easy!  I made this to go along with some Greek suddenly salad and they were perfect mixed together.  I sauteed mine in a skillet rather than grilled them since I used smaller shrimp.

Made this with our mixed grill of pork steaks, beef steaks, smoked sausage, and chicken thighs.  This was the first to disappear.  Was delicious and we'll defnitely be making this again! Thanks for posting.
So easy and so delicious! We used medium shrimp and instead of skewers, we just grilled in our seafood basket. Excellent recipe. Thanks!

Made these tonight for the first time.  My whole family loved them, even the 4 year old.  I love the smokey flavor of the cumin and the zip from lime. Being in AK we eat lots of shrimp... this is a new favorite for sure!
Wow so easy. I followed the directions exactly and it was yummy. I didn't grill the shrimp, I just cooked the shrimp on the oven and served over angel hair pasta. A keeper.
This was really good. The tang of the lime complemented the natural shrimp flavor.  Definitely a 'make again' dish.
Excellent...will use this recipe often. I love grilled shrimp!!
First time we've ever tried grilling shrimp - LOVED IT!!!  Couldn't eat a lot at one sitting, but look forward to trying a surf-and-turf style dinner with it!

Shrimp isn't my favorite food but I decided to give this recipe a try for a 4th of July BBQ. I was surprised how much I liked it! It was very tasty and the first time I really enjoyed shrimp, not just tolerated it, and wanted more. The only reason I didn't give 5 stars is that there was too much of an oregano taste for me. So next time I'll just put a little less. Definitely try this!
Not bad! I added some red pepper flakes for an extra kick. A little spicy, but that's the way we like it!
very flavourful and easy to make!!
Very good flavor.  I cooked mine on a George Foreman grill and it turned out very well.

This was super easy and really really tasty!  I doubled the recipe, put all the marinade ingredients in a gallon sized baggie and let it sit in the fridge for about 30 minutes or so, then my hubby grilled them.  Very flavorful, loved the zing from the lime!  We will definitely be making this more this summer!  thanks for a great recipe!

We had these tonight. I left out the cumin (not really a fan), marinated the shrimp in the mixture for about 5-10 minutes, and then skewered them (on wet skewers) and put them on the grill. Simply delicious! We ate them with corn cakes w/sour cream, which was a lovely combination.

I was excited about this recipe but it ended up being a big fail. It was SUPER salty. To the point where it was inedible and I had to toss all of them. I made exactly to recipe including the grilling directions. The shrimp were super tough. I know it wasn't the shrimp either because I made a different recipe on the same day with the same batch of shrimp. Sad...and sorry for the bad review but having to throw it out really sucked
Even though I overcooked the shrimp, the taste was still amazing enough to win everyone over, even my wife who has historically not enjoyed shrimp.

Decided to make my cold tomato sauce for dinner tonight and needed something to do with shrimp to work along with it. This dish was perfect! Light with a lot of flavor that didn't compete with my pasta sauce. I didn't change anything just followed the recipe as shown. Quick and easy and will surely be a repeat at my house.
Pretty good, double the sauce and let marinade for 30 mins in fridge. Definitely keep on the lower end of the ranges for salt etc. In the recipe.
I added a spash of seasem oil, sugar and substituted black pepper for red pepper flakes. In addition I used granulated garlic one 1/2 tsp. It came out really good. I will make this very soon again.
Swapped the cumin for paprika, added a dash of red pepper flakes and cilantro, cut the salt down. Super tasty! Used colossal shrimp grilled on the BBQ
We tried it; it was pretty "meh". Not particularly flavorful.
excellent recipe. Made for a party exactly as written and they were gone in minutes. Definite keeper

Nice flavors, best recipe I've tried in a long time. But because I didn't have enough lime I used both lemon and lime. Left out the zest, used less salt and only 2 large cloves of garlic. Very nice without it being too overpowering, loved the citrus; almost a ceviche shrimp.
Love this recipe! Super flavorful, lovely aroma, and easy to prepare. This will be a favorite for dinner parties.

My husband and I love this shrimp marinade so much! We make this at least once a week. We marinade it for a half hour, skewer it and then grill it. We either have it in a salad or shrimp taco. It's delicious with this chipotle aioli sauce, avocado and romaine or cabbage: 1/2 cup mayonnaise 2 canned chipotle peppers 1 tablespoon lime juice’ pinch of salt
Zurie - loved this simple dish!! The vermouth is excellent with the b.sprouts!!

I love my Brussels sprouts and love making them different ways.  This was simple, yet had nice flavor.  I did use the dry vermouth and the caraway seeds.  I love caraway seeds!  I wouldn't hesitate to use half caraway and half flaked almonds next time.  Thanx, Zurie!

When the hubby gives Brussels sprouts a big thumbs up...you know you have a winner...I prepared mine with the almonds and the dry vermouth...they came out nice and tender with a bite to them...oh...I did locate the flaky sea salt...at...$29.99 a pound...I got $2.70 worth...but...I didn't notice any thing special...so don't waste your time and money locating the special sea salt...thanks for posting it...Made for Fall PAC 2012

You are sooooo right, Kate.  "So simple, so easy--and such good flavors."
The asparagus was young and so tender; the combination of red roma, and green asparagus, added to the flavour.  All was consumed by 11 eager, Easter dinner guests.  My sister copied the entire menu and printed a copy for everyone.  Dinner was an adventure, your Asparagus Provencal one of the highlights.... Thank you Kate for sharing,

This is a simple and elegant way to serve fresh asparagus.  I cooked the asparagus in the microwave until crisp tender and proceeded with recipe as specified.  The fresh basil really adds the crowning touch.

Great recipe! Fast too! I simply blanched the asparagus, beautiful green, and then added to the tomato, shallot, garlic and basil mixture. How nice....this was. Refreshing on a hot day, and the taste was as fresh as Spring.

I loved this, a simple recipe, easy to prepare with excellent honest, fresh flavors of the food.
A perfect side dish for so many meals. I will be making this again! Thank you.
ZWT3
I love asparagus and I loved this.  A really easy and nice way to dress up asparagus.  NO LEFTOVERS!! Made for ZWT III

This was EXCELLENT!  More than restaurant quality.  If you love the ingredients...you won't be able to help but love this.  I had a lot of very nice ripe sweet tomatoes available when I made this recipe so I ended up using about 8 tomatoes in this recipe (you can use as many as you want and I don't think it would hinder this recipe at all) and I increased the shallots and garlic.  The fresh basil was perfect for this.  I think even an asparagus hater couldn't help but love this because asparagus wasn't the overwhelming flavor in this.  It was a nice blend of all ingredients.  This was really great and will be a staple in my house.

Lovely, fresh flavors. We added some green beans because we only had about half a pound of asparagus. We also used sweet cherry tomatoes rather than romas simply b/c they were in season here. Light, flavorful and yummy!
Loved this recipe...I did add a little fresh oregano to it...Great way to serve asparagus...
Very good!  Used sage instead of basil because I didn't have any, but still worked.

This was delicious!  I used it with chicken wings and my hubby praised it while licking his fingers. The only change I made was to use 2 cloves of fresh garlic instead of poweder.  Thanks for a great recipe Danlyn!

Very tasty!! Loved the sauce too.  Used chicken legs only and cooked for 45 minutes plus 15 minutes instead and they turned out great. Served with pasta and italian green beans, but next time will try serving with dilled new potatoes and a salad, which DH and I both agree would compliment the main dish even more. Would not change a thing about the recipe!! Thanks for sharing!!

This is a nice tasting recipy.  I didn't have any dry mustard, so I used prepared, and I added about 1 tsp. of garlic powder.  I thought the sauce could handle it. When the chicken was cooking, I found the sauce to be really liquidy.  The chicken was almost braising. After the cooking time given, I put the chicken on a baking sheet and put it back in the oven to crisp up.  I added about 11/2 Tbsp of cornstarch to the sauce and cooked it until it thickened a bit.  I served it with rice and a salad.  I think some hot sauce might be nice added to this recipy too.  
I can see how this would be good with chicken wings.  Thanks for posting.

This was a big hit with my kids and husband.  I substituted chopped garlic for the garlic salt and served over rice.  The sauce was a little thin, so i think i will thicken it up a bit more next time.  All in all, a nice, easy dish.  Thanks Danlyn!
I used chicken breasts and served it over rice. The sauce is great. I made this with chicken wings as well, finger licking good!

I loved this recipe but my boys were not crazy about it.  We served it over rice and most of it was gone.  They said it tasted like sweet and sour chicken and I agreed.  Unfortunally they don't like sweet and sour chicken and I do!  Thanks for the recipe!

My husband made this recipe tonight, and it was delicious.  I can't believe how easy it was to make something so good.  We will be having this alot in the future.  The sauce is excellent over rice.  (He substituted 1 t prepared mustard for the dry, he used minced garlic instead of garlic salt, and red wine vinegar instead of regular.)

We really enjoyed this chicken and the sauce is great over rice. Very easy to make.. Will be making this again.  I doubled the sauce and used 3 cloves of minced garlic instead of garlic salt.  Thank you for this recipe.

This was SOOO good! I used fresh garlic (and lots of it) instead of the garlic salt.  When the chicken was cooked and the juices from the chicken had mixed with the sauce, I used a turkey baster to collect the sauce and put it in a small sauce pan, and let the chicken crisp up a little inthe oven.  While that was happening, I thickened the sauce and added broccoli.  I then served the sauce and broccoli over rice.  I hate to say it, but I think this dish has bumped my favorite sweet and sour recipe, which I've been using for years. I couldn't wait to have the leftovers the next night!

I made this dish last night and it was delicious!!! I didnt have 90minutes though for the oven so I cooked the legs in the sauce with the lid on in the microwave for 15minutes then in the oven for a half hour with the lid on then left the lid off for a further 10. The chook meat fell off the bone! I also substitued the dry mustard for wet and garlic salt for minced garlic in a jar. Thanks for a top receipe!!
This was good...Thanks for the recipe.

I mixed all the sauce ingredients together, put the chicken pieces in a freezer bag, poured over the sauce, and froze for about a month. Then yesterday, I took the bag out of the freezer, and dumped the contents into the crockpot, set it on high for six hours, and left. I came home to an incredible smell! I dumped in a couple cups of wild rice mix into the crockpot, and an hour later or so we ate the most delicious chicken and rice. What I love about this is the fact that it combines OAMC and my crockpot! What could be easier?
Great recipe. Easy and delicious! Used fresh garlic for more flavor. My family loved it! It's now in the dinner rotation!

I was really disappointed with this recipe.  I wish I read previous reviews, as my sauce also did not thicken.  I also had to take our chicken out sooner, as it was overcooking. Our chicken was tender, but was lacking any flavour. I guess all of the flavour was in the sauce, but the sauce wasn't sticking to the chicken. I'm sorry, I won't be making this again.

I doubled the sauce in this recipe to make sure we had extra.
My husband never rates a recipe higher than a 3 but this one he rated 4 1/2. 
Really great. Will make it again.

Very tasty dish!  Made it exactly as stated in recipe.  A little too sweet for my taste, maybe next time I'll use less sugar.  I will definitely be making this dish over and over!! (I found it best over white rice).  Thanks for the recipe!!

This is a really great sauce.  I cut the honey in half because I was trying to cut down on calories (also used Splenda brown sugar for the brown sugar) - it still tasted great. I also used a few cloves of pressed garlic instead of the garlic salt.  I had boneless skinless chicken tenders so I only cooked them 45 min. total.

This recipe was really good. I used fresh minced garlic instead of garlic salt, and i upped the salt to about 1/2tsp. I served it with Mashed potatos and rice as well. It seems to be a recipe that will become a regular dinner... next time I make it i think i will try boneless chicken thighs though. This recipe was simple and quick.

My husband and I thought this was very good but we both thought it was too sweet, maybe too much honey.  I think if I make it again I'll add brocoli and carrots to it or something.  The sauce is good over rice and we did thicken it up for that purpose.

Saw the recipe and it sounded sooo yummy so I made it for dinner this evening. I used 4 cloves of fresh garlic instead of garlic powder. Before adding the sauce over the chicken I tasted it and found it to be super sweet even though I love sweet things. I added a TB. of soy sauce to take an edge off the sweetness. My chicken seemed to be floating in the sauce once it was cooked even though I followed according to directions... AND I only used HALF the amount !! I served it with roasted carrots and rice. An okay recipe but I doubt I would make it again. My DH and DD felt the same way. Thanks for posting.
This was quick and easy. I served it with rice and green beans, I poured the sauce on the rice. I will use this recipe again .I think I'll add 1 clove of garlic the next time.

This was wonderful.  I cooked the entire time then put on baking sheet and cooked for another 10 mins to get crunchy texture and while doing this added cornstarch and water to sauce to thicken up both of this as this is what a couple other reviewer said.  We loved this.  I did as you mentioned and marinated this starting this morning for about 9 hours before cooking.  I served this with wide egg noodles instead of rice as this was a family preference.  Thanks for posting we will be makeing this again!!!  LOVED this!!!

Wow easy and delicious.  My dh made this chicken, (and he's NOT a cooker) and it was so very good.  My dd and I really enjoyed it.  There was no left overs, so he fixed it again the next day.  It was just as good.  Thanks :-)
This was a great recipe so yummy, and with rice just perfect!  We all had to fight over the last pieces.

I have to say that this recipe is easy to prepare, but it was not what we expected.  I threw everything into a ziplock and froze it a week or so ago.  Tonight I defrosted it to cook.  We both thought the sauce was a little too thin, and did not add enough flavor to the chicken.  It also was a bit too sweet.  The chicken was very tender though.  Sorry that it wasn't our favorite!
Very easy to prepare and the chicken was very tender. I used chicken thighs instead, as that's what I had on hand. Next time I will thicken the sauce a bit. Tasty! :)

Wow!  This was really great chicken.  I substituted apple cider vinegar (its what I had on hand), prepared mustard for dry.  I would use fresh garlic next time... Also, baste the chicken a few times when you are cooking it with the lid off and thicken up the sauce after.  But the flavor is right on.  It tastes like Sweet N Sour, but better.  I served it on white rice .  I want to fix this again and again!  I might make more sauce next time because it cooks down some and then when you thicken it it cooks down more.

I made this last night, It looked like the sauce was going to be really really sweet so I used tomato sauce in place of the ketchup, I also substituted prepared mustard for the dry and white wine vinegar. If you Love sweet bbq sauce you will love this recipe, it was just way to sweet for me. I also had to thicken the sauce with cornstarch which may be due to the tomato sauce I used instead of ketchup. Super easy recipe though and easy to customize, I will try it again without the honey and brown sugar.

Very nice and sweetBBQ sauce taste. I didn't add the salt since I thought it had enough with the garlic salt and the soy sauce and  I used cider vinegar. Next time I may uncover the chicken sooner to get the skin a bit more crisped.  I spooned the sauce over the chicken and loved it. Thanks!

I thought this was good, but way too sweet for me and a little bland. I added about a 1/2 T garlic powder, but I would even add more next time, and maybe some black pepper and crushed red pepper. I would also put in less brown sugar and honey, but that's my personal preference, I guess. The bake time was perfect! Chicken was really juicy. Served it over rice.
Loved it! And so easy..seems like it can easily be made for OAMC too!

I really liked this and i dont really like chicken thighs! i add a few splashes of Tapatio hot sauce and it had a nice little kick.  I didn't have a problem with the sauce being too thin because i let it sit in the oven for about one hour after i cooked it and it thikened on its own.  after reading reviews, i cut the honey and sugar down to half and it came out awesome! thanks

This was very tasty chicken! I did remove the chicken from the sauce for the last 15 minutes of cook time to crisp them up, which worked out really well for me. My picky daughter ate two pieces! That says something! Thank you for sharing this one!

This is my all time favourite recipe.  I used chicken breasts and cubed and cooked them first. Then put the sauce and chicken in a casserole.  I made it in the am and just put it in the oven 20 min to heat just before supper.  Next time i'm gonna try this sauce over meatballs or ribs.

This was fantastic!! A definate husband pleaser. I used a whole chicken that I had portioned and fresh garlic instead of garlic powder. Just the perfect amount of sweet for us. just fantastic. Thankyou for posting.

Very nice recipe - I changed a few things I felt it needed more taste so I added cayanne pepper which went great with the honey!

I think the ketchup made it a bit odd - next time I'll skip it or add a honey/brown sugar BBQ sauce instead...

But it kept the chicken moist and it was very good, I also made a batch to freeze (raw chicken in the sauce) for future use

I really liked the tangy sauce, but it did not thicken on the chicken. I had to pour the sauce into a saucepan and cook it until it reduced to a thick glaze. Then I spooned the sauce over the chicken. Served with rice.

This was really really good!  I ran out of honey so used some light corn syrup and added a bit more brown sugar.  I used spicy brown mustard instead of the dry.  I also added 3 minced garlic cloves and some minced fresh ginger.  I baked it at 350 for 45 min covered, then took it out and removed all the chicken.  I added some cornstarch and put the chicken back in.  I baked it at 400 for another 25 minutes and it was a beautiful thick and glazy sauce that was perfect for spooning over the chicken and rice I served on the side.  My family devoured the chicken, but I'm rating it a 4 because even after everyone used sauce for rice (there was 3 of us) there was still A LOT of sauce left that I had to dump out.  Next time I will halve the sauce and enjoy just as much with less waste!  Yummmmmy!

I gave this 4 stars. My family loved this chicken. My 6 yrs old niece ate 2 good size thighs after saying how she didn't want chicken for dinner. I used 4 good size chicken thighs as that's what I had on hand. I will be making this for my family again for sure. Thanks for posting a yummy recipe. Christine (internetnut)
We really enjoyed this chicken even though I just marinated them in the sauce then grilled. The flavor still came through and it was really good, will make again! Thanks.
This was soooo good!  My husband and kids loved it.  Definitely a keeper...thank you

a bit like sweet n sour chinese but still very good. marinated the chicken in the morning and had it later for dinner. this came out better the second time around! my first try got burnt a bit including the sauce. i use a fan assisted oven, so i adjusted the setting the next time. 190C for the first 45 min (i covered my dish tightly with foil) Then i poured out the sauce in a pan, removed the foil and cooked my chicken for further 45 min on 165C. i added cornflour gradually -tsp at a time- to my sauce on med flame till it thickened the way i like it, which i later poured over my chicken. great with rice. thanks!

MMMMMM this chicken is very good. I thought about thickening the sauce but decided to try it the way posted the first time around. The sauce stayed way too runny so I took the chicken out and broiled it for the last 10 minutes while basting it with the sauce. Next time I will take a hint from Chef786983 and remove the sauce to a pan to thicken.....a very good recipe tho..Thanx danlyn.

This was a pretty good recipe. My family liked it a lot more than I did so I guess that's what counts. I did as Chef 786983 recommended and drained the sauce after the first 45 min of baking to thicken it on the stove top with cornstarch. I covered the chicken as much as I could with the thickened sauce with 15 min left to cook and it came out great. We will definitely cook this again as it's pretty easy and tasty.

Very tasty for both young and not so young...used chicken thighs and covered chicken when done in order to thicken the sauce for use on rice!! Made it in the morning and left in the fridge while enjoying Sunday football - very easy for a tasty meal! Will definitely make again.

Very good sauce. I used a minced garlic clove instead of the garlic salt and prepared mustard instead of dry. I also didn't add in any additional salt since there's already  ketchup and soy sauce in this recipe. I cooked this sauce on the stovetop and served over baked chicken and brown rice. A real keeper, thanks!

Very nice and easy meal.  I followed this exactly and was pleased with the results.  There wasn't any leftovers so I know my family liked it.  I will try some other combinations in the future, but this is a keeper, THANKS!!
this was ok - sauce turned out really thin, and didn't permeate the chicken, tasted like a sweetened ketchup to me, didn't really taste the honey or garlic

I really love this and have cooked it a couple of times, but it was too sweet the first time, so I cut the sugar and honey in half which brings the rest of the flavours out more, its gone into my book of favourite recipes!

I made this recipe for lunch today. I read the other reviews and cut the honey down a bit and added a little more soy sauce and garlic. It was amazing! An instant hit and had everyone wanting more. I will definitely make this again. Thanks!
Absolutely Delicious!
I wouldn't call this a honey garlic chicken, however it was really good. This was more like a sweet and sour recipe. still very good.

Wonderful and easy.  It was a bit of a whoopsie as I forgot the mustard power, but never missed it.  Next time I'll consider draining the sauce and thickening.  Or maybe not.  Meets my criteria of easy, cheap, and time saving, as the prep time is minimal.  Might try this with pork chops.  Thanks for the recipe.

I wish I could give this more stars. The flavor was good, but for some reason I couldn't get the whipping cream to thicken. Not sure if it was my doing or not. I used the rum and orange zest. To me the orange was over powering. I may try to make this again  soon because I feel that it deserves a second chance. I do have to say that the candied pecans were right on!! Thanks for posting. I will update my review soon.

I had no trouble at all with this VERY, VERY NICE recipe! The candied pecans are a wonderful addition, & the pumpkin cream can out VERY TASTY! I did use the OJ instead of the rum & thought that it, along with the zest, gave it a great flavor! Definitely a nice change on a winter's day 'pumpkin-anything'! Thanks for the keeper! I liked this dish but would omit the cloves of garlic. There are so many other flavors going on here that it doesn't need it.
My hole family loved this recipe.There was alot of chopping for me but I think it is worth it.It is also VERY filling and VERY cheesy,just what my family loves.
very good - i added a small can of coarsely chopped water chestnuts for a bit of crunch.
I made this recipe tonight, and it was excellent!  I liked all the ingredients in this dish. I wouldn't change a thing.  My son especially liked all the cheese.

This is very good.  I did not pre-cook the rice. I am a garlic lover and loved the flavor. Kinda "Garlic Chicken and Rice".  Mmmm Mmmm!  I think next time I am going to make it without the rice and serve Over noodles. (Just to try and see)
I traditionally do not like chicken casserole dishes.  This one was excellent.

I made this recipe 4 times in the last 3 weeks 
it was really a big hit with my family. My son especially loved it beacause he can reheat and eat ... And its very simple and quick.

I found it a little salty, but that would be easily solved by using a low sodium soup.  I would also recommend that you drain the juice from the chicken before adding the other ingredients, as the final product was quite runny until it was chilled.  I would like to try this without the velveeta as well... if anyone has tried this let me know how you did it.  Serving it with a toasted garlic ciabbatta bun really topped it off.
My whole family really liked this and they are hard to please.  I did use low sodium soup and unsalted butter.  I think its great.  Thanks
this was absolutely delicious.

I really enjoyed this recipe.  I have made it twice for our family so far and everyone loves it.  Since I tend not to worry about fat, I added about a cup of shredded cheddar cheese to the mix to make it even more cheesy!
Wonderful!  Everyone had at least 2 helpings and sometimes 3, including DH who never takes seconds. Thanks for posting this.  I will be making this again and again.  So easy too!

I can't even say enough good things about this recipe.  My family gave me two big thumbs up.  I used two bags of boil-in-the-bag rice, which is more than the recipe called for.  I sprinkled colby and monterey jack cheeses on top.  It was one of the best dishes I have ever tasted!  Of course, my family loves cheese.  We'll be having this one again soon.  Thanks!!

Therese,  I just had to post another review.  I made this recipe as is, as you know, and it was totally fab - no doubt about it!. However, what a great recipe to play around with depending on your time, mood, etc.!  Tonight I added about 1/2 cup of diced red bell pepper, 1/4 cup of diced green bell pepper, extra garlic (we adore garlic), and one diced jalepeno.  I topped it with a combo of cheddar, swiss, and grated parmesan.  OMG, too delish.  Thank you, Thank you!!!!
This recipe was very easy to make.  It had a wonderful taste as well.  We really enjoyed it.
Not TOO impressed.  Nothing wrong with the recipe or the taste, just not anything special or one that I would make again.
I was looking for something quick...this was wonderful and delicious!  Everyone loved it and fought over who would take what little was left for lunch the next day!

Although this recipe was easy to prepare,(I already had cooked chicken and rice), the taste was just not there for me. Very bland. I served with garlic bread and fresh steamed asparagus which made it palatable. I'm sorry Therese, this sounded good and has a lot of good reviews but is not something I would fix again.
YUM!  Very easy to make, too.  I did leave out the 'shrooms, as I'm not a fan.  The garlic really sets this one aside from the rest.  Will definitely make this again.
This was great!  My wife, however, likes more spices, etc.  I don't! So, this recipe was perfect for us both.  If she wanted more "zip" she added it herself.  She liked it alot. Thanks for sharing.
Wonderful!  I used muchroom soup instead of chicken.  Yum!

This is a regular in my house. Since I'm not a huge fan of mushrooms I leave those out and use cream of mushroom soup instead of the chicken. I always have leftovers for lunches, and it reheats so well!

Delicious recipe and very rich tasting.  Hard to believe so low in calories - which is a plus.  I cooked up some fresh broccoli, which was a nice addition in the casserole.  Used a bit less shredded cheese on the top.  I will be serving this one for company!  Thanks, Therese Crosby.  M. Joan
We really enjoyed this.  I halved the recipe, used cream of mushroom soup, and substituted cheddar for the Velveeta.  We'll definitely be making this often in the future!

The two dreaded "c" words in my house (ds hates chicken and dh hates casserole), yet BOTH of them ate it!  DH even begrudgingly admitted that it tasted good!  I did add a bit of parsley and tarragon since I usually find just onion and garlic to be too bland.  Also omitted broccoli so they would actually touch the thing (they are way too picky!!).  I thought it was very good, better than the usual chicken and rice dish.

Yummy! It was the perfect "comfort" food for a chilly day. Had to do without the Velveeta (thought it was in the fridge and it wasn't!) so I substituted another can of Cream of Chicken Soup.  Also omitted the mushrooms as no one in our house will eat them and used leftover rotisserie chicken.  Will definitely make it again, and next time I'll be sure to have Velveeta.  My picky 2 1/2 year old loved it...what more is there to say?

"It's no italian sausage ziti" says my husband but treated he and kids just fine for a Thursday night dinner.  I used real cheddar instead of velveeta and left over brown rice.  I used fresh broccoli and cauliflower florets.  My kids ate it and that is all that really matters.  thanks for helping me out in a bind.

I have to admit right from the start that i made many substitutions to this recipe since I didn't have everything needed and was entirely too lazy to go to the store...
That being said... this was an AMAZING base recipe!!  I used left-over, precooked chicken from Sundays roasted chicken night, 6 slices of american cheese and a little bit of cubed swiss cheese (thats all I had on hand), and I sub-ed miracle whip in place of the sour cream...  used the same swiss cheese on top for the grated... and a can of drained mushrooms in place of the fresh... it was lovely even with all the replacements!!!  I can only imagine how good this would be if we had everything needed for the proper recipe!
Just what we wanted on an early fall evening! Thanks so much!!

Very good, we loved it, we love lots of cheese ha ha. I used fresh broccoli because I needed to use it up, I didn't measure I just eyed it, probably use more than what is in a package. Will definately be making this again.

Extreme cheesiness, and I only put 1 out of the 2 cups of shredded cheese on top!  I wouldn't recommend using any more on top. LOVE the fresh mushrooms in it and the garlic.  No salt needed since the Velveeta is salty enough.  It needs to be creamier though, so next time I will add some milk. An excellent recipe.
Great taste and kids enjoy it.  a salad and some fruit all of the  basic 4.  Thanks.
I loved this recipe and I will make it again. My hubby liked al but the broccoli part. He doesn't like any veggies. LOL! I thought it was wonderful though!

Left out the mushrooms.Had no onions. Used cooked,shredded chicken and made homemade cream of soup. Even with those changes this recipe is great. Easy to do and 3kids,dh and I loved it. When Dh got home from work he asked what we were having and when I told him he wrinkled up his nose and said are you serious?? I said,just wait til you try it. Well,after the first bite he said. it is really good!!! He ate three servings and took leftovers to work today!!! That says it all!!
Great comfort food, with a more interesting taste than many chicken and rice casseroles.  I used canned mushrooms rather than fresh, but it didn't seem to make any difference.  Definitely a keeper!

I used cooked shredded chicken as that's how our family prefers it in casseroles.  I didn't have any garlic, and will be sure and have it on hand for the next time I make this delicious dish.  I've made hundreds of chicken and rice casseroles over the years and my college-aged daughter said last night, "this is the best one you've ever made".  Wow, I'll take that compliment any time!  Thanks for a great recipe!

Great Recipe.  I have made it several times with variations, depending on what I have on hand.  It is always great!!  Yogurt works well in place of sour cream and I really like adding fresh spinach instead of broccoli.  Thanks for posting!!!

Made this last night. Boiled the chicken and shredded it. Omitted mushrooms because I don't like them. Added chicken seasoning to the chicken, and threw in a little bit o' chicken base for flavor. Baked in my stoneware casserole dish. Let me just say that this turned out SO DELICIOUS I could not WAIT to eat this for lunch today! It's not even 11:30 and I just had to dig in! And let me tell you what the BEST SUPRISE was --- the shredded cheese created a WONDERFUL crispy crust on top! DEEEEEELISH! (Boyfriend thought it was fab but a little bit too cheesy. Is there such thing?!?! He's crazy!) THANKS FOR SHARING! WILL MAKE AGAIN!

What an absolutely delicious chicken casserole.  The only thing I did differently was to not mix the broccoli into the rice, instead I placed it on top of the casserole before adding the shredded cheese.  I find sometimes when using frozen broccoli that has been thawed it tends to be a bit "mushy" when mixed into other ingredients so opted for placing it on top.  Will definitely be making this again.  Thanks for a great recipe!!

Casseroles are not my idea of fine dining...but they do the job on a cold night and tight budget!  That said, this was a good one.  I left out mushrooms, doubled the chicken. don't believe in Velveeta cheese soooo, I used 1 can mushroom soup and 1 can cheesy broccoli.  I used 16 oz broccoli rather than 10 and regular rice.  I also increased the onion.  This turned out well and my kids ate it up.  Why don't I make more casseroles??? lol  Keeping this one.
Great recipe! Thank you!

I would say this serves 4-6, good flavor and an easy throw together meal.  I used non-instant rice, easily made while you dice/cook the chicken.  I omitted the shredded cheese topping, opting for bread crumbs mixed with a small amount of margarine, also I used American cheese slices in place of the Velveeta, as its what I usually have on hand
Quite tasty. I subbed barley as I was out of rice and it was delicious. Thanks for a great recipe!

Very tasty casserole!  DD and DH both loved it.  Only thing I changed was that I used a 16oz bag of frozen broccoli instead of the 10 oz box, a little more than the 2 cups cooked "regular" rice,  and I reduced the amount of cheese on the top to 1 cup from 2 cups.  This a keeper!  Thanks!

Just made this tonight to take to a friend.  Very easy, tasty and quick to prepare.  I doubled the recipe with no problem and made an extra to keep in my freezer!  I would and will make this again.  Thanks!

I've made this recipe many times and my family loves it! I tweaked it a little bit by not using velveeta cheese or onion, but I do put plenty of shredded cheese and substitute the onion with onion powder since I need my 2 year old to eat it too. haha. Oh and usually if I am in a rush I just throw everything into the pan and cook it for about 45- 1hr and it still comes out amazing!

This was yummy!  I left out the sour cream (DH doesn't like it and I didn't have any that I wouldn't have made myself), but it was great without it.  So creamy!  I don't use instant rice and I think the long grain made it even creamy.
this might be my husband's favorite dish!  it gets even better as a leftover, and it's so easy to make.  Thank you!

Wonderful recipe! I tweaked the ingredients a bit to make it healthier: brown rice, light Velveeta, 99% fat free soup, light sour cream and light margarine. I also used fresh broccoli. I look forward to having leftovers tomorrow! Thanks for sharing this recipe that everyone should try.
Made it with Spinach instead of Broccoli and it was delicious.My Husband loves all Casseroles and I guess he will ask for this one more often Thanks for posting this

The family really liked this!  I'm not going to pretend I made this healthy but I improved its health somewhat by using brown rice, bumping up the broccoli, using olive oil instead of butter, and leaving out the sour cream altogether.  Overall, creamy and yummy. Thanks for the recipe Therese Crosby...
Family favorite and super simple!! Love it!!
My husband and kids loved it. It was a little dry to me...I will add more broth or cream of mushroom next time.
This is pretty good.  I used 2% Velveeta and it came out just fine.  Enjoy!
Love this!  Made exactly as written except I doubled the recipe.  Will definitely make again.
This was really good.  It was not runny at all when it was done.  Cheesy and crunchy and good.  A great weeknight meal.

My husband and I enjoyed this.  I left out the mushrooms as I had none, and added some milk for a smoother consistency.  I also added some crumbled Townhouse crackers with drizzled butter to the top.  I will definitely make this again.

Made this when couldn't think of what to make and what an excellent choice.  Creamy, flavorful and easy to put together enough for a crowd.  Used chedder cheese on the top and then topped with panko crumbs for some added crunch.  So good, will be keeping this on the list for frequent use.
This was a very good recipe, thank you for posting!
This is a good base recipe, but we thought it was pretty bland. I even doubled the garlic since we're garlic lovers.

Increase chicken
Bread crumbs on top
No instant rice; Long grain rice instead
Really simple recipe that truly made my day. First time ever making a casserole and I think this just became one of my favorite dishes. 10/10 Thanks!
Great. Make sure cook rice all the way if in microwave 15min not 4 rice take lot longer than that bit lot better if cook on stove

I made delicious casserole this evening and everyone raved about it! I did increase the soup, Velveeta, and cheddar cheese. I also added garlic powder and onion powder to enhance the fresh garlic and onion flavor. Like another reviewer, I added some milk for a less thick consistency. This is a wonderful base recipe that I look forward to making again and again.
Love this recipe!! we added some dressing for the topping and that turned out wonderful!!
Delicious!
easy and delicious!!!
Very tasty, healthy, and extremely easy to make! A keeper! Thanks!
I haven't been able to find cardamom anywhere around here so this fit the bill perfectly!!  Thanks so much for providing an easy alternative!  Turned out great!

I wish I could give this more than five stars.  It was an absolutely wonderful dish.  All of the bits and pieces were pretty and worked well together.  I was surprised at how filling these lettuce tacos turned out to be.   I plan to add this to my best of 2013 cookbook.

What a lovely meal this recipe made.   The marinade was delicious, the chicken perfectly seasoned and cooked.  The chili sauce was dynamite, slightly salty, but delicious none the less. The flavor of the assembled taco was incredible, salty, tart and tangy, you could also taste the ginger and garlic, we loved it. We decided to use the cellophane noodles option. The tacos were a  little messy to eat but that was part of the fun.  I made them exactly as written but couldn't get bibb lettuce so  used a nice young romain lettuce, it worked pretty well.  Really great use of the contest ingredients, Good Luck in the contest.

Very good! Love it being low cal. A fun dish to make and eat. Yes a little messy but its all fun. I did use 2 breasts and did slice before marinading. Then after cooking I cooled and broke apart in small pieces for easy filling into the lettuce. As for the chili sauce I skipped the soy using only the fish soy, being the sodium is more then 1/2 of your DV. I didn't marinade long because the lime juice can make the chicken mush. So this step can be done first and and let sit while prepping the rest. You won`t lose any flavor. I did oil my pan before cooking the chicken as I don`t believe in non stick pans. I also added some sweet pea pods from the garden. As I chopped the nuts I thought adding some to the dipping sauce to thicken it a bit would have been good. I used fresh grown greens from the garden. I did add to the plate thinly slice jalapeno, onions, red bell peppers. And for the herbs I minced cilantro, basil, holy basil. To the cellophane noodles I added some of the sweet chili sauce to coat and flavor. Nice creation. Good luck.

Yum and double yum! I cut the recipe in half and did cut the chicken into thin strips and marinated 5 hours which was tasty and perfect, think 24 hours would have been too long for these thin strips and just as a matter of personal choice will cut the strips into thirds next time. Had some homemade sweet chili sauce left from yesterday that did not have ginger so add a teaspoon of fresh ginger and thought it went fantastic with these oh so yummy and oh so healthy Thai Tacos. This meal does make for one very pretty table and makes healthy eating fun. Good luck in the contest and thanks for the great post.

These lettuce wraps are absolutely delish!  Loved all the flavors; especially the chili sauce.  I marinated the chicken overnight and had no problem with saltiness from the soy sauce.  Took the advice of one reviewer and added some chopped peanuts to the chili sauce.  This makes a wonderful light lunch that is very satisfying.  Made for ZWT9.
These are great!  Colorful, crunchy, and flavorful.  We enjoyed all the textures and how well everything came together.  Thanks for sharing!  ZWT9
love it!
The ingredients seem few and simple but the taste was mouth-watering good! I will be making this one again for sure!
Extremely tasty and easy recipe for broccoli.  Just became one of my favorite ways to eat broccoli...thanks so much!
Nice nutty flavor.  A pleasant switch from plain ol' steamed broccoli.  Was even better cold.
I planned to try this cold tomorrow but unfortunately, there are no leftovers.  Very good.  Next time I might consider toasting the sesame seeds before adding them to the broccoli.
Another great way to serve broccoli. I will definitely stick this in my keeper file. Thanks Caroline!

YUM! This was really good- even my dd loved it! I agree- toast the seeds before- added flavor- can do it in the micro - toast for 30 sec- then 15 more if needed til done to your liking. The soy gave it a darker color that was not really visually appealing but lighter soy could be used for a prettier dish- if you are looking for pretty- the flavor definitely more than makes up for the dark color. GREAT dish! It is a keeper for this house! 

Thanks Caroline Olivia!
I didn't care about anything else on my plate when I tasted this!  Can't wait to make it again.

I love how easy this is and if you like sesame you'll enjoy the flavor! I think you could get by with even less oil than shown, if you want to lower the fat content even more, but it was great just as is.

This was a nice side dish, easy and nutritious. I didn't have sesame oil so I used olive oil, maybe if I had used the correct oil, it would have been more flavorful... but even still I thought it was good.

This is a excellent broccoli dish.  The sesame oil is what turns plain/ordinary broccoli into an outstanding dish and one that will please your guests.  I followed your instructions exactly and wouldn't change a thing.  Thanks so much for sharing Chef 148068.

What a great idea for dressing up an otherwise 'kinda OK' broccoli side! The only thing I did differently was to add another tablespoon of sesame seeds, & the broccoli came out very tasty! Thanks for this great recipe!
Love it! This is such an easy and good way to add flavour and interest to plain steamed broccoli. My whole family asked if I would make broccoli this way from now on. Excellent!

This is a fast and easy way to spruce up broccoli.  That said, it wasn't exactly what we expected.  I think we prefer broccoli with other flavors, but it is a change of pace.  If you like sesame flavor, give it a try!
Made this to go along with "Recipe #76930" and it was the perfect choice.
This is an excellent variation on regular steamed broccoli!  YUM!

I am not too crazy about this recipe.  My family didn't like it either.  Thanks anyway though.

These were great.  I will most def. be making these again.

Wow, so very, very, very good! I do like broccoli but don't love it - unless it's done like this. Then suddenly we are all fighting over the last little bit of it. Thank you for an outstanding recipe!

Yummy! 5 year old said 5 stars and asked for more, that's got to be a compliment! Thanks
Very easy and tasty!   Not much to add to previous reviews.
This is really good and easy to prepare. DH and I loved the flavor, but DS wasn't crazy about it. I served this with recipe #68955. Thanks for sharing!

This was yummy!  I I love sesame oil and soy together--I often fix green beans this way.  My son doesn't like seeds so I toasted the sesame seeds separately and added it to my broccoli only.  Otherwise followed to a "T".  Thanks for posting kiwidutch!
Great, even without the soy (ooops, I forgot in the frenzy of trying to get dinner on the table!). Wonderful with or without. Thanks for sharing!
Great broccoli!  Easy to prepare!  Great with fried rice!
Sesame oil pairs beautifully with this delicious broccoli. I took your advise and toasted the sesame seeds. I also used Japanese soy sauce. Thanks for posting. Made for ZWT4.
I also toasted the seeds for extra flavour.  This was delightful accompanying a salmon dinner.

This was so quick and easy to make.  I agree that toasting the sesame seeds enhanced the flavour!  I made this last nite as a side dish to accompany Recipe #164706.  Made for a delcious combination.  Made for ZWT4.

I steamed my broccoli and then just tossed it with the oil, soy sauce, and toasted seeds. Very nice nutty flavor. Made a nice accompaniment to Recipe #29210. A nice way to dress up broccoli. Thanks. Made for ZWT4.
This was quite good. I did cook it a bit too long (after you begged us not to, dang it) We will have this again, my hubby really enjoyed it, thanks for sharing!

This is so wonderful.  I used frozen broccoli defrosted in the microwave and then just tossed it on the hot sesame oil.  I did add extra oil at the very end of the cooking -- maybe a half teaspoon.  I will be making this often!!

Yummy! We loved this. You really can taste the sesame flavor so don't be surprised when it happens. This was so easy to prepare and I just love the bright vivid color of the broccoli. It has a nice crunch to it if you don't overcook it. Thanks for posting. :)
yummy
I steamed the broccoli and toasted the sesame seeds in a skillet. Great flavor! Thanks kiwi!

I love this!
I add chicken pieces, water chestnuts and place on a bed of white rice.
So easy!

This was sooo tasty!  Instead of pre-steaming the broccoli, I followed recipe #155018's instructions for pan-roasting. My family... including my 3 children aged 8, 6 and 3, LOVED this dish!  I served it as a side with salmon marinated in sesame oil, honey, lime and soy... served with slices of orange!!!  So tasty for being so simple... thanks for the great idea.
I've made this several times now and really enjoy it! It's a simple side dish that is healthy and tasty. I've even added some sliced bell peppers for extra color, flavor, and nutrition.

Yes, this is exactly the way I prepare my broccoli too! Except I don't steam it beforehand. Great! Made this morning to pack into today's  lunch box. It worked out perfectly and tasted great come noon. Made as written and will make again. Thanks so much for the post.
Easy and so yummy! I toasted the sesame seeds which helped bring out the flavor. Thanks for a great recipe!
more of 3.5.  good flavor.  simple and quick to make.
I agree...simple and quick to make.  Minimal ingredients.  Flavor wasn't bad, but it doesn't come near to displacing my favorite broccoli recipe from Alton Brown.
Not alot of flavor..sorry
This is a great spinach side dish.  I used fat free cream cheese.  It's wonderful.
This great. I made as written except I added 1 extra pkg of Splenda. It is easy to make too. Thanks for the recipe.

This is SOOO good! I used red pepper flakes - 2 ts, just the right amount of heat for me but a little too much for my 13yr old son. I use one lb of ground beef but double everything else. I think I could live off this stuff. Thanks for sharing a great recipe!

This was very good we thought1 Soo simple! I did substitute ground turkey breast in place of ground beef in order to save calories, still very good! Great for low carb, low cal or diabetic!!! Thank you so much for making life a little easier!!!

holy guacamole batman! this stuff is GOOD! I've heard of this recipe for years and never tried it.  I got it a little too sweet and tried to balance it with more vinegar. i used splenda drops since they don't make the quick packs any more :(   Next time I'll use the powdered for closer measurement.  This is seriously good stuff.  I'm not a big fan of ginger, but I love this stuff.  Cures my cravings for sweet/sour/hot chinese food.... thanks so much!!!

We loved this! Our picky eater went back for seconds, which is rare. I used chili garlic paste for the sriracha because I was out, rice vinegar and a touch of honey since we don't eat artificial sugars. CHEAP and EASY and on the table in less than 30 minutes including chopping the cabbage, THANKS for posting.

Amazing!  Made it tonight.  Newly diagnosed diabetic hubby loved the stuff.  It was quick and so easy to prepare.  Skipped the sugar/Splenda.  It was quite good, but I might go higher on soy sauce and lighter on vinegar next time since I'm skipping the Splenda.  I suspect this is about to become a new constant menu option.
I love getting the flavors of Chinese food in a low carb, easy to make dinner!  I haven't tried this with ground beef yet but made it with shrimp and mushrooms tonight and it was wonderful.
Great way to use up veggies, anything goes... I made mine without meat.  I didn't have the Srichachi sauce and use chile oil in its place.  A few drops was quite enough.
Appropriately named!  I could eat this every day.  I use rice wine vinegar and spice it up with extra sriracha.  My extra picky hubby even said it was good!
I made this tonight for my husband--he says it is a definite keeper! Although I am wimpy when it comes to spice, I thought it had really good flavor as well. Thanks for the recipe!
Awesome recipe. Worked great with the pork sausage I had on hand.

Finally tried this recipe last night, and it was a total hit.  Made it as lettuce wraps, and totally altered the recipe but it was sooo good. LOVE this addictive dish.  I use broccoli slaw and ground turkey - just our prefernce; otherwise, follow to a "T".  Thanks for posting.

This was very good. I substituted  ground turkey breast for the beef and broccoli slaw for the cole slaw and did not use the Splenda. I also substituted the low sodium soy sauce with Briggs Liquid Aminos. Will be making this again. DH is on a low carb post Bariatric surgery diet.

Great recipe. Easy and tastes great. I usually chop both red and green cabbage - fresher.

This is awesome!!! Will be making this on a regular basis. I thought I had ginger around but I didn't and I omitted the sweetener.
Since I've made it and variations of it so many times, it's time to rate it 5 stars.

I love this dish. To me it's best with Aloha Soy Sauce.
So delicious! Skipped the Splenda and vinegar, and used ground turkey and about twice the sirraccha. Really great in a wrap or as a topping on some quinoa !

My daughter told me about this recipe and I tried it today for the first time.  The flavor is great but next time I will double the sauce portion of the recipe.  When I first tasted it I thought this would make some very good egg rolls and how easy would that be!!!  Can't wait to try them.

This was a great recipe. I served it over rice. I used ground turkey instead of ground beef. Instead of splenda I used a bit of sugar and a little sweet wine. I'll be making this one again. I love good cabbage recipes.

I used ground pork-my favorite are pork eggrolls. And I used double the sesame oil. Delish!
Husband and 11 year old son loved it, will definitely be doing this recipe again.

I used ground turkey, shredded 3 types of cabbage, (napa, regular, and red) carrots and a ton of scallions. Added more ginger, garlic and just used agave for a little bit of sweetness. Hubs and the 4 year old loved it! Added some heat to mine on my plate and it was perfect!

My new go to dinner!!!! I did tweak the recipe.....I used ground chicken. I doubled everything except the meat, and even more on the garlic and scallion. I also made extra sauce to spoon onto the lettuce wraps. I LOVE THIS RECIPE!!!!

Love this recipe!! Tweak it as needed for portions, but this is delicious if directions are followed correctly.. (Any bad review is bc either someone can't cook or can't read and follow directions..) bc it's yummmmy!!

Love it!

Loved this! I changed the ground beef to turkey, and used 10 oz instead of 14 of the coleslaw mix. I didn't have splenda so used 1/4 teaspoon erythritol and changed the white vinegar to apple cider vinegar. IT WAS DELICIOUS! Seriously make this! I make this every week its so good!

Delicious! I did similar swaps just for what I had on hand, I shredded up a head of cabbage and half a red pepper, used coconut aminos in place of soy sauce and crushed red pepper paste in place of sriracha and still...delicious. Thank you!
This is fabulous! Cooked beef, added all other ingredients right in the same pan. Poof voila! Also added sliced almonds to serve. Definitely making this again.
I didnt use Sraracha sauce (dont really care for it) but instead used Chili Garlic Sauce which is a thick spicy sauce (low carb too!) and it was great!!

I only find this to be just okay. I've made two different versions of crack slaw. I really don't find it to be awesome or addictive but it is a good simple dish for the low carb lifestyle. I'll probably make it again but for me it's just middle of the road.

Made exactly as written and thought it was quite tasty.
Great recipe. Easy to make. I added a little extra soy sauce.

Most excellent dish! For those complaining about the dish being bland, I used 1-1/3 pound of ground turkey, which has very little flavor, and added almost another half the amount of volume to the dish, thus less taste overall. This is an epic recipe for our house.
So good!!

Fantastic !! Comes together quickly. Over the years of making this, I've stopped adding the Splenda, sugar, or any sweetener. You can sub chicken, shrimp, or any proteins. All will be super yummy.

This is a go to recipe for me while I'm acclimating to a keto way of eating. I see reviews noting blandness. I make a double batch and take it to work for a weeks worth of lunches. I used a few individual packets of Swerve for the sweetener but it could be left out. Very satisfying recipe.
This is GOOD! Skip the splenda and add extra Siracha. It tastes fantastic without the sweet.

Yummy recipe!

Delicious! I used turkey sausage (0 carbs) instead of ground beef. When I plugged the ingredients into Carb Manager it came out to 8 net carbs per serving (4 servings total).
Love this recipe. Have made multiple times and changed it up using ground pork and broccoli slaw instead of cabbage. It is definitely addictive!

Wonderful scones that are very easy to make, especially in the food processor. I didn't do cinnamon on top-- just sugar, and I added 1 tsp of vanilla extract. Cut into 8 wedges, they took about 15 min to bake to a light brown in my oven.  Great with butter and raspberry jam. Thanks, prettyinpink!

I chose this recipe for my first scone baking try, and it worked out great!  Very easy to follow the directions, and the dough was every easy to handle.  I used the 1/4C. of sugar and added a scant 1/4 tsp. each of ground clove and cinnamon.  Yummy!

Really good!  My children loved them.  I think they ate them all before my husband even had a chance to try them.  I guess I'll have to make them again. I will probably add some cinnamon to the batter next time.  YUMMY!!!

This is a great recipe!
I like to divide the dough in half. One half I pat out the circle and sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar - this is my favorite. The other half I gently knead in chocolate chips (minis are good)- my kids like these the best. Each circl makes 6 scones. When on hand I serve them with jam and whipped cream,yum,yum!

these were not only very simple to make but the taste was so very good.  i had to really rush making them as i have a very busy 1 1/2 year old so they didnt look as neat as they should have but the taste was very uncomplicated and delicious. the texture was perfect too. i may try adding raisins next time.  my daughter and i loved them.
The recipe was simple, both with ingredients and instructions!  I added dried cherries and the scones turned out the perfect sweetness!!

These scones are perfect for those who want a delicately sweet, but simple confection - I used 1/3 cup of sugar, but I have mine plain with coffee. KEY: Make 2 rounds, not 1. Also, I prefer cutting each round into eighths, as they bake better. Cut each round into quarters, and then neatly bissect each quarter into two equal triangles - they come out more evenly than slicing across the round to make eighths. Baste with milk, and sprinkle liberally with sugar to make a flavorful coating. I had to bake mine for 15 minutes to get them done. Delectable and reassuring comfort food.
This is a great and EASY recipe! It would be great with fruit or orange zest added.

True to their name, these scones are simple and sweet. I have made them twice thus far, and they came out beautifully both times. I like to sprinkle a bit of cinnamon sugar on top before I bake them, but they are delicious with or without it. Though I haven't tried it yet, I imagine these would go very well with preserves.

My first attempt at scones. I halved the recipe to make 8 wedges. Used about 50g of butter, 2 T sugar & a handful of raisins. These were fantastic fresh out of the oven with strawberry jam and even when cooled. I lowered the temp to 210deg C when they got brown coz it seemed a bit too fast in my oven. So quick and good. Forgot to sprinkle on the sugar and cinnamon which I prepared but they were so tasty and with great texture. Will be making these again very soon!
These are soooo good! I made half a recipe for me and my husband. We had them with raspberry jam. All I can say is yummy. Thanks!!
My best friend and I made these this past weekend after watching the Food Network:) My first time making scones and these were SO good with blackberry jam. MMMMM! Thanks for an awesome easy recipe!
I must have done something wrong because they crumbled were crumbly but still delicious. We serrved them up warm, with raspberry jam, butter and Devonshire cream! Yummm!

This is an extremely simple recipe that can be adapted in so many ways!
