YUM!  Can't wait to experiment with other flavor combinations - thanks for posting! -M  (Note: I like to form the dough into a rectangle and cut 6 squares, then cut each square diagonally to get 12 scones.)

Made these again as a "welcome home" surprise for my folks who were returning from MN.  Orange & cranberry is their favorite, and I have found that cutting the dough with a biscuit cutter is much easier than forming the traditional wedge-shape.  They also seem to bake more evenly.  -M =)
YUM!!!  I used 1/2 cup chopped dried apricots and 1/2 cup chopped pecans.  Wonderful!!

I was given the task to make scones for my department's Christmas High Tea, and having never made scones before, I came here to find good recipes. Easy, light, sweet scone recipe.

Many thanks!

I used my KitchenAid mixer and had to pull the dough into a ball on the counter, as it didn't come together in the mixer. I also halved the recipe and made 8 scones, although it would have been better as 6 larger scones. Great recipe!!!

These were a nice and sweet tasty treat.  I added some white and milk chocolate chips and a bit of vanilla to the batter. Chrissy

Update!  Baked another batch this morning and just followed the recipes cooking instructions, baking at 425 F. Thanks again!
Very tasty! Cooked them for a bit longer because our oven sucks. They turned out really well though :)

i made these for my dd tea party and the kids didnt eat much of the food but these were a big hit i doubled the bathand made 24 smaller scones and i also added some dried currents verry tasty thank you
A nice basic scone recipe you can use as a basis for all kinds of flavors.

I'm sorry - I really didn't like these.  I followed the directions exactly, and after they were baked, and cooled, I tried them - and it tasted like I was eating plain flour. I dumped loads of sugar and cinnamon over the top though.

I put in the 1/3 cup sugar, used Blue Bonnet Homestyle margarine (1/2 the fat) and cut it to 1/3 cup.  I put 1/2 teaspoon of cinnamon in with the flour and added 3/4 cup cinnamon chips. I loved these scones!  I followed the directions except I did use the tips from another reviewer to make two rounds and smaller pieces.  I cut them into eigths and kept them close so the edges stayed softer.  I took a little heavy cream and brushed the top then sprinkled with cinnamon sugar.  
Really enjoyed these!  They weren't dry like some others I've attempted to make.  Will definitely be using this recipe often.  I also love how quickly the recipe comes together, so easy!  
Thanks!

Excellent!  I made a plain batch and followed a tip from another reviewer and added dried cranberries and zest of an orange....oh they were so yummy!  They went over well at the baby shower tea party too.  Thanks for a keeper!

Super easy and super tastey.  I split the dough into two balls and for one I added a handful of raisins that were about to dry up in my cupbaord and the other I left plain.  They both taste great.  I love mine warm with jam and butter.  Mmmm!  Thanks for the recipe!
This has become my go-to scone recipe for all occaisions. Thank you for posting.
just made these this morning for breakfast, and they are great!  I substituted 1 cup of flour with whole wheat and added blueberries.  And I am trying not to go for my third one!

These scones are so light and fluffy. I modified it by using Splenda and Smart Balance and added in golden raisins and crushed almonds and hazelnuts, but the texture of the scone is so biscuity and amazing. This is my new go to scone recipe. Thanks for posting!

So easy! I made these with the full 1/3 of sugar and substituted vanilla sugar. I tossed in a few tablespoons of chopped walnuts and drizzled a simple maple glaze over the top when they were hot out of the oven. YUM!
This is the 3rd scone recipe I've tried in the past couple of months and this is my favourite. Very good texture, light and fluffy, and it tasted fabulous! Glad I stumbled upon this recipe.

These were too dry even for a scone. I gave it two stars because I'm fond of them being dust dry, but, unfortunately, none of my tasters are. This was a big disappointment. If only it were summer so I would have strawberries and could make some soft of trifle with it instead of it going to waste.

Definitely a five star recipe. This was my first attempt at scones and they came out so perfectly. Not to cake-like and definitely not too dry. This alteration in cooking time could be because of the size difference. In any case I will be making these again and will try out different fillings and flavors. Thank you prettyinpink!
These scones are delicous. Very easy to make and came out perfect. I will be making these over and over again.
I made these for my mom's students when they were learning about Ireland. They LOVED them and the assistants ate them up as well. I used the 1/3 cup and they weren't overly sweet. Just right.
Turned out Beutiful!  They were gone with in minutes of comming out of the oven.  This will become a new staple in my personal recipe book!

Yum! **Updated to say: I make this recipe quite often! Delicious!

This is the perfect scone recipe.  They come out so light & taste delicious!  I love the sugar & cinnamon sprinkled on top with my favourite addition to the mix - a decent handful of chopped dates. So easy! Great with fresh fruit on the side and coffee.

Overall a pretty good recipe. The scones baked up nicely and puffed up in size. It was missing the 'scone' flavor that I'm used to, perhaps due to too much butter and a tad much sugar. I just popped these out of the oven and am getting crumbs all over the keyboard as I type.  But wanted to add my rave review! This is an excellent base recipe for all kinds of scones. The recipe makes 16 1 1/2"x2" or 8 3"x4" scones. I prefer larger scones, but have found that I need to add about 8 minutes to the cooking time for them to bake through. There are a few basic tips that will make them come out perfectly every time. First - Chill everything. Butter, flour mixture, formed dough and baking sheet. This dough is butter heavy and if things aren't properly chilled the butter will melt, rather than evaporate, in the hot oven making the scones slump. Second - Grate the butter on the large hole side of a box grater and toss with the flour mixture. It's easier than cutting in and the scones will come out light and airy. My favorite addition to this recipe is to add a quarter cup of currants, soaked in orange juice then drained, to the dough. I top the cooled scones with a glaze made of confectioners sugar, orange zest and orange juice. I've also made them savory by omitting the sugar and stirring chopped sundried tomatoes, shredded mozzarella and dried basil into the dough. Brush with melted garlic butter and top with a sprinkle of parmesan before baking.

A trick picked up somewhere, helps make them flakier. Something about refreezing the butter I think. Also if you fear you will overwork the dough and melt the butter when you cut the butter in, freeze the flour mixture first, keeps heat from affecting things. Wow, this was so wonderful.  My whole family just loved it, thanks for this great recipe!!

Wow-za! :-)  This dip IS awesome, outstanding, delicious, delighful, delectable...I could go on and on, just like all of the other reviewers, this dip is soooo good! This was just ok.  With everything in it, you'd think it would have more taste.  It was a lot of work cooking all the bacon.  I made it for New Year's and threw out over half of it the next day so it wasn't very popular.  With so many other good dip recipes out there, I won't be making this again.
This recipe is amazing! i followed it exactly, with some of the low-fat options, made it for five people, and it was gone within 20 minutes.  thanks so much for the recipe!

Made this for a New Years party so i doubled the recipe.. While the bacon was time consuming, i was happy how it turned out! I thought it has a perfect mixture of flavors and served with townhouse crackers. Made it once since then and will definately make it again.
This was great! Didn't have the green peppers and only had half pound of bacon, but it turned out yummy anyway! Got completely devoured!
This dip is so good you will have to force yourself to put down the cracker and walk away. Unless you dislike bacon, there is no way to rate this recipe anything other than 5 stars.

An absolute winner! I took this to a party along with a couple of other dips and this was the one that everyone kept commenting on. Will definitely make again! The only change I made was to chop the bacon prior to cooking it instead of crumbling it after.
it was just ok. Had a ton of it left over.
This was delicious. Everyone loved it. I added a little Beau Monde and Herbes de Provence.
This recipe is awesome! My family loves it when it is in dip form, but to change things a little I made it into a pasta dish, just mixed it normally and put penne pasta in it. Awesome!

Wahoo! This was terrific! Bacon makes everything better. ;) The crunch of the green pepper is essential and lends a crispness to the dip. I didn't add onions and it was still a great dip. Thank you for the recipe, I'll definately add this to my favorites. I made this for my family 4th of July BBQ.

I already made this recipe 4 times and it became the favourite dip that I serve during BBQs. While cooking bacon, I add the onions as well as I prefer cooked onions rather then raw. I use 3 medium onions instead. I have already shared this recipe with 2 aunties who took the bowl near them and didn't stop eating until it finished :)
Not a fan, very thick and salty.  Maybe it was the brand of bacon I used.  Thanks for posting anyways!

YUM!! I substituted Morning Star Farms Bacon for the bacon but otherwise made as directed. I was out of lettuce but that would have only made this recipe better! I made this for game night and it was gone in a flash. I served mine with white corn tortilla chips and I will be making this again and again! Thank you for sharing this!

This was pretty delicious. I accidentally added the whole 8oz block of cream cheese instead of half but it came out great. Also added a little bacon grease (about 1/8 cup) to really kick the bacon flavor up. Very good and will certainly make again. Thanks for posting.
Made this to take as an appetizer on Thanksgiving . . . served with pita chips and veggie sticks.   Delicious!  My daughter and I had the leftovers for breakfast!

Used a orange pepper for color and green onion as onion was too strong.  Did not add lettuce.  Everyone at the 2 parties I went to liked it but there was still a lot left over.  DH didn't care for the overall texture, he likes dips that are more blended but I didn't count him in when writing this.
This was good.  I added a decent amount of pepper and extra salt.  I still felt like it was missing something..... maybe fresh garlic?  I'm not sure, but it was a great base to work with, thank you!
I only made 1 c. of this dip but loved it.  Great with Flipsides.  Still have leftovers after using it as an appetizer.

This is seriously one of the tastiest dips I have ever eaten. It was a huge hit at my Superbowl party this year! Everyone ate it all up! It was wonderful with plain Wheat Thins. I also subbed a few things to make it a tad bit healthier such as turkey bacon instead and also light sour cream and  light cream cheese and mayo. I also used green onions which made it fabulous! It is okay with lettuce but I didn't think it was necessary. It is great without it also. t would highly recommend this for any occasion. It is guaranteed to be a hit!
Best dip ever.  Made it for first time over weekend.  Was hit of party. Made another one for office party a few days later and nothing left.  Would not change a thing.

Made this exactly as the recipe says. It was super yummy. I served it with corn chips in the afternoon. During dinner, my DH ate it with some pan-fried fish. It was surprisingly good with seafood. Thanks for the recipe!

Made it as directed and it was wonderful!  It is even better when it is allowed to chill in the fridge overnight.  Makes 3 cups or so -- plenty for a party or potluck.  I will definitely make again and maybe add a bit of chopped green chile next time just to change it up, but it is still excellent as is!
Football, wings and bacon dip! I served this with wheat thins and tortilla chips. My family seemed to like it better with the tortilla chips.
I made this exactly as you have it and it was so good...I don't think I will go back to the boxed stuff again.  Thanks so much for sharing this great recipe.
This was very good. I followed the directions exactly. I topped each serving with sour cream and cheese. I will be making this again for sure. Thanks so much for posting!

This was very good and easy to make.  My taco seasoning was a bulk package that I found in the produce dept of my grocery store- it gave no indication of the "hot" level.... with 4 Tbsp that the recipe called for made our meal extremely hot!  Next time I will either use less, or make sure that my seasoning is a mild blend.  I will definately try this recipe again though!

I loved Hamburger Helper as a kid but just can't stand boxed mixes these days. So it was really fun to try this recipe and we all loved it!  I didn't have and groundbeef, so we used hot sausage.  I also used my own homemade taco seasoning.  It took a little more water than the recipe called for.  Terrific and fun recipe!
This was great, it did taste just like hamburger helper.  Thanks for posting!

This was good and easy to make during the week. I needed to add a bit more liquid (about a cup more) to cook my noodles in. I used a whole packet of taco seasoning as my family likes seasoning. We all enjoyed it.

With my additions I give it 5 stars.  I added a can of Rotel, decreased the water by 1/4 cup, and added a chopped red pepper with the onion.  I doubled the cheese.  I served it topped with sour cream and sliced avocado.  I don't buy Hamburger Helper because of all the crap in it (MSG, HFCS, dyes, etc) so this recipe was very helpful.

Overall this was very tasty.  I was out of hamburger, so I used some "fake meat" that I keep on hand for myself.  My kids loved it, but said it was a little spicy. Will definitely make it again.  I also had to add a bit more water while cooking, but it might be because I used whole wheat noodles.
Delicious and quick! Love it for one of those days where you want something fast but not spaghetti!

I made this last night and it was so bad I couldn't eat it. I made it according to the recipe. I won't be making it again. Sorry - just wasn't good at all. It smelled like dirty socks and tasted like I would imagine dirty socks taste like. Yes - that bad.

My mom's been making this for over 30 years.....
She used l lb gr beef, 1/2 chopped onion, a package of onion soup mix, 1 tsp oregano, 3 c water (no milk),1-14 oz tin of diced tomatoes, 2 c macaroni and a handful of shredded cheese (use one you like such as a cheddar mozza mix)
I made it tonight subbing 1 pkg taco seasoning for the onion soup mix and 1 tsp cilantro for the oregano.
It's a quick filling dish that families can enjoy and it's good for leftovers.

The really excellent thing is that you can sub almost any of the ingedients for similar ingredients that you have on hand. The main thing is that the meat (or meat substitute if you are vegetarian) should be a ground consistency, any small macaroni type pasta is fine, any grated cheese that you like will work and most any powdered soup mix that you like will do. If you don't like tomatoes, experiment with any other 14 oz can of veg or even fruit like canned mango,pineapple or mandarin oranges.
Go ahead! Create!
Very good stuff!
Bland,no taste. I threw it out

These are very delicious kebabs with a definite Polynesian flavor that hints of sweet and sour with tones of ginger. I think this recipe would also work well with shrimp or chunks of ham. A real winner! Thanks, Inez!
My family loved it! The chicken was very moist and flavorful. I added a small red potatoe and zucchini to the skewer. It was a complete meal. I definately will make this again. Can't wait.

These kabobs were the hit of my Hawaiian Luau!  I made skewers with chicken and skewers with pork.  For the chicken, I actually purchased the frozen boneless chicken breasts from Sams Club.  For the pork, I bought boneless pork chops trimmed the fat and cubed.  For veggies, I also used onion and red pepper.  I didn't serve the rice, since it was easier for people to eat standing up without it.
Very yummy, and a nice variation on regular marinated chicken.  We basted a lot while grilling and everything had so much wonderful flavor!
I enjoyed this meal a great deal!  I look forward to finding more recipes with such good outcomes.  My guests were amazed...
This was a great crowd pleaser and so easy to make!  Especially since I have a handicap in the kitchen.  I definitely plan to make again.

Delicious! Everyone around the table, including the kids, loved this and devowered it quite quickly. I used prepared mustard and minced garlic because I didn't have dry mustard or garlic powder. It was so flavorful, I will definately make it many times again. Thanks for posting such a great tasting dish.

These were delicious! The chicken was so moist and heaps of flavour! I used chicken thigh fillets as I had no breast but yummo! I also cooked them under the grill in the oven.Definately a keeper and be making it more often
very good! quite easy to prepare and the chicken turned out juicy and tasty.  I didn't have ground ginger so i used 4 teaspoon of minced ginger.  i also added onion. Thanks for a great recipe
These were so yummy!!  I love the pineapple with the chicken, so good.  Nice simple, tasty, and fast equals perfect!!  Thanks for sharing!!
This was just excellent!  I made enough for four, but my husband and I finished it all in one sitting.  Served along with coconut rice, this one is definitely a keeper... thanks!

Inez, these were absolutely wonderful.  The flavor of the marinate made this recipe.  I did marindate mine for about 6 hours, but otherwise made as directed.  Served this over Basmati rice cooked in chicken broth.  Made for a wonderful meal. Thanks for posting

Really good recipe. I fixed it for our supper over the weekend at the lake. Everyone loved it. My DH even wanted me to take a photo of them on the grill. I did add steak along with the chicken. I let the meats marinade in the juice all morning. The flavors were nice. Thanks for sharing this recipe!
This is an excellent recipe.  I made these for supper and thoroughly enjoyed them.  I will most definitely be making these again.  Very tasty and easy to prepare.  Your recipes are great MissNezz!!

These Kabobs are my new favorite summer recipe!!  They are so easy and simple to make.  I wrapped bacon around the chicken as I put them on the skewers and alternated them with the pineapple and veggies(we like portabella mushrooms, red peppers, red onion and zucchini).    Put them on the grill and brushed them with the marinade every 10 min. until done.  So yummy!!! Thanks for the great recipe!

I have to admit that I was skeptical about this recipe as I was preparing the marinade, but it turned out very well.  I used red onion and red pepper instead of the tomatoes and mushrooms.  Everyone in our family liked it.
These were absolutely delicious and very easy to make!

Superb!  Cooking for 2 (DH & moi) could not have been easier, much less tastier.

This is wonderful and I will make again a.s.a.p.!

Cooked this for a luau party we had at the weekend so i doubled the quantity! They were the first to go....lots of compliments and not a skewer left for the cook :-( So i will have to do them again so i can see what all the fuss was about!!  Thanks for sharing your recipe MizzNezz
This was outstanding! The marinade was out of this world. My family wants to know when we can have this dish again!
Absolutely terrific.  Made it just as written.

All I can say is Yummers!!!! The whole time we were eating my husband and I were saying WOW, and YUMMM! We were wanting shrimp so we used that instead, and it was great!!! We also used fajita meat too, which was just as good!
This was so great!  The marinade smelled and tasted wonderful!  I'm so glad that I tripled this recipe because these went FAST!  Thanks for a great way to prepare kabobs!

This is a beautiful recipe. My husband and I aren't big fans of mushrooms and cherry tomatoes so we used zuchinni and red potatoes instead.  I'm going to have to cook those potatoes longer somehow next time.  This was so yummy!

Another fantastic recipe by MizzNezz!  I was also skeptical about the marinade, but they were absolutely delicious and perfect for our BBQ. I will be making this one again!
Really good, thanks so much for the recipe!
Easy and delicious. I will be making this recipe over and over! Thanks for a keeper!

Loved these! The marinade is PERFECT! I used grape tomatoes, pineapple, green pepper, onion, and chicken. The whole family loved it. Oh yeah, the grill was out of gas so I baked them in the oven instead. They still turned out great! Thankyou for posting such a great recipe.

Well, I just had to try this because of the high ratings. I was skeptical at first. But, this recipe made the best kabobs I've ever had. These were great.  The chicken was really tender and flavorful. I followed the recipe (which is unusual for me) and was happy with the results.  I served this with Chinese Fried Rice.

This was absolutely fabulous. We made it at my sisters house and everybody chose what they didn't want on their kabobs. The chicken was so tender and good. Oh Darn, I guess we'll have to make them again.

Tried the recipe again after a first time successful result.  The chicken once again was moist, tender, and flavorful.  I understand a marinade adds flavor, but I am not sure how the chicken can be moist & tender from the use of a marinade, but it works that way.  Loved it again.
I made this for a girls lunch and it was a hit!  I marinated the meat over night and it was very tender!  I will definately make again.  Thanks!

WOW!!!!!!!!!These were absolutely awesome.  We used chicken breast and thigh meat.  For veggies we used onions, peppers, mushrooms, potatoes, and pineapple. We served it over fried rice. Everyone loved it from 38 to 3.  Even my hubby said it was really good and he never says that about anything.

This is a very easy and tasty recipe. I had a pork roast in my freezer that I needed to use. So I defrosted it and used that instead of chicken. Since it was a little old I marinaded it over night, It came out so yummy and tender. Thanks MizzNezz for the wonderful recipe!

WONDERFULLLL!!! These are a definite keeper and will be made often! Tips...#1 Soak your wooden skewers for an hour so they won't burn. #2 From my dh- keep the larger chicken piece in the middle for easier turning if you are using tongs.
I thought this was very good.  Might leave it marinating longer but otherwise thought is was good. Thanks for the recipe.  Will make again!

An absolute essential recipe for your summertime grilling. I made this last night and it disappeared quickly. Everyone in the family loved it, and it's rare that my picky kids all like the same thing.

Wonderful,I used some shrimp also with the chicken.  Left off the tomatoes and mushrooms and used red bell pepper and tiny new red potatoes.I marinated mine for three hrs. Will make this a lot.Thanks for the great recipe

Oh yeah, I've found another new favorite kabob recipe!!  Marinaded the chicken for a little over one hour.  Easy to make and had a great flavor!  Everyone liked them.  I made this for my daughter, her date and 5 other of her friends that came over to have their dinner here before Prom this spring. The chicken was really moist and juicy and the vegetables came out well.

This was so good!! I cooked the veggies separate, but the chicken was so good. I can't wait to make this again.

Fantastic!  We made these yesterday for an impromptu bbq/party.  I think the chicken soaked in the marinade for about 1 1/2 hours.  And in another batch I marinated some beef cubes.  The chicken was sooo tender and tasty; everybody loved it.  Leftovers today!!  Thanks for a great recipe my friend! :-)
These are fanstastic...I made these for our neighbors for dinner and everyone raved about them...the flavor is wonderful...
Very good marinade.  I served this with fried rice. It made a wonderful meal.
fast, easy, and very tasty!
Great marinade!  I marinated chicken breasts and put on the George Foreman Grill.  My husband loved it!  Thanks!

These are picture perfect! I love the colourful presentation of this meal. I made this recipe as an OAMC recipe by freezing the chicken in the marinade in a ziploc bag. The meal was delicious and all my my supper guests gave this recipe two thumbs up! Thanks for posting!

Great kabobs!  I Made them for my husbands birthday luau.  I put the marinade together two days in advance.  I marinated the chicken for 24 hours.  The only problem we had was that they stuck to the grill, but we oiled it down and that seemed to be the problem.  Thanks!

This was FABULOUS!  They chicken was moist, flavorful and delicious!  I marinaded it for about 3 hours, and we used fresh pineapple (the best!), cherry tomatoes, button mushrooms and onion wedges.  They took about 15 minutes to grill over medium heat.  Everything was as yummy as can be!  Thanks for the great recipe!

I also thought that these were really good!  I made these for a medium sized party and together with a few friends, we probably assembled 40 kabobs, and they were ALL gone by the end of the night!  Thanks a lot!

Delicious!! We eat grilled chicken in our house a few times a week and I'm always on the lookout for a tasty marinade that is not salty tasting. This is perfect! The flavor is so wonderful and it makes the chicken very moist and tender. I served this with Perfect Brown Rice Perfect Brown Rice. Thank you for posting this great recipe that will be a regular in my house.

Wow! I made these kabobs a couple of times this summer and they were perfect for casual entertaining. I join the pack on this one..Made the sauce last nite to have it out of the way..Marinated as directed- thought I had enough marinade to put some in the freezer..not the case.. YUM!  We really enjoyed these!  We just returned from the Carribean and were in the mood for something like this - it was just right!  Thanks for a great and simple recipe!

Delicious! I made it this winter on the grill in 32 degree weather!

Took another reviewer's advice and brushed the marinade the raw chicken sat in over the kabobs as they grilled. Nothing was wasted.

I used red onion for sweetness and mushrooms. Absolutely delicious!

Nice recipe for the grill.  My guest was more enthusiastic than I. Used both red and green pepper so it was quite attractive.  I wasn't terribly hungry at dinner time - perhaps that affected my view.  Would try this again because it was well received by my guest and will review again at that time.  Thank you for the recipe.
WOW!! this recipe is soo amazing.  the chicken came out so moist and flavorful!
Great marinade! I grilled them on a grill pan without the skewers! Can't wait to try them on an outdoor grill. Thanks!
Let me just add to the rave reviews. LOVE this marinade. Very tasty.

Great marinade!!  I left out the tomatoes from the kabobs but made several different kabobs using chicken, pineapple, red potato, zucchini, red onions, mushrooms, and red, green, and orange bell peppers to suite all my guests preferences.  I will definately be making this again at our next BBQ!
So delish!!  I had to use minced garlic and prepared mustard...I also used red onion, zucchini in addition to the veggies in the recipe...SO GOOD!  THANK YOU!!!

We loved these!  I just served it with rice so it was more like 4 servings for us, but if I had a salad or another side it would probably serve 6.  They were very easy and quick and the chicken was so tender.

This recipe was super easy and VERY , VERY TASTE. We used beef instead of chicken and it turned out great. Can't wait to try it with chicken next time. These kabobs were fantastic!  Very easy to prep and very tasty!! I used 4 large chicken breast for my DH and I and we have more than enough for leftovers during the week.  Thank you for sharing this terrific recipe, I will be using it often!!

This recipe is outstanding. There wasn't one kabob left!

I made this on a warm spring day when it was sunny and breezy and I had a terrible craving for kabobs. The marinade was fantastic, the meat and veggies came out deliciously, and my craving was more than satisfied. Thanks thanks thanks!

have used this a few times this summer and everyone loves it.

The quintessential summer meal.  Must be some reason why 88 chefs have given this recipe such great reviews.

Awesome, my family loved this recipe. This will be one of our favorites. Thank you so much for this wonderful recipe.

So good! Everybody at my BBQ loved these!
