I've already gone back for an after dinner piece!  I'll make this one over and over!

My family really enjoyed this recipe
Bamabelle. I liked it because it was quick and easy to prepare and tasted wonderful. I will be making this again and again. Thanks Bamabelle.

Quick, easy, and good.  I substituted vegetarian grounds for the beef, and it worked fine.  I had to cook it about 10 extra minutes to cook the crescent rolls all the way through, but when it was done it was very tasty!
Loved it!!!!! Thanks for such an easy recipe that tastes great.

Fantastic!! Had to leave it in the oven a little longer. Used 2% cheeses and reduced fat sour cream. Left out the butter. Added italian seasoning to the meat mixture. Definately a make again meal. There were no leftovers!!!

Delicious!  This is a keeper!  I added a few things to the ground beef...a little Italian seasoning, green pepper, oregano and garlic.  The spaghetti sauce I used was Hunts good ol' plain spaghetti sauce, so I thought it needed a little extra seasoning.  Otherwise I made this exactly as is.  My DH compared the sauce to his grandmothers!  This was a fabulous recipe and will be a staple in our house.  Thanks so much for posting!
This recipe had a little too much sour cream for our tastes but was otherwise very good.
This is great. I used about 1/2 the sour cream because my husband doesn't care for creamy dishes, and it turned out wonderful. Easy, and feeds a crowd.

This recipe was amazing! I was a little skeptical with the sour cream, but it was wonderful. I had 2 servings! :o) I cooked mine for 18 minutes, and I had to put it back in the oven for another 5 minutes because the butter made the top of the cresent rolls a bit soggy. The additional 5 minutes was exactly what it needed! Thank you so much for sharing! I will definitely keep this recipe on hand! Thank you!!

I'm mixed on this one.  It was a little bland, but I do think with modifications it will be better next time.    I added more spaghetti sauce than called for as other reviewers indicated (1-1/2 cups), but mine was a tad runny as a result.  I also added more cheese "just because" (a mozarella / provolone blend) and it was definitely too much.  The meat / spaghetti sauce did need more seasoning, so next time I will definitely add italian seasoning as someone else mentioned.  It was a pretty dish, though.....I'll definitely try it again, and scale back the sauce & the cheese.

My wife and I tried this one because we had all the ingredients, so we thought. Somehow we missed the sour cream and realized we didnt have any. So in a crazy effort to continue making this, we mixed cream cheese with a little milk then added the cheese. I know it sounds weird but it accutally worked. My wife and I seem to think its better this way.This was an extremely easy and very tasty meal. I wasnt sure what we were going to get but we were pleasently suprised. One thing I did do is season the meat while browning with pepper, garlic powder and salt then added green pepper. I will make this again and will recommend this to someone.

This recipe tasted great! I made a few adjustments and additions. I added 8 oz of mushrooms & 2 tsp of Tastfully Simple Season Salt to the hamburger mixture.  Inceased the sauce to 1 3/4 cup, the mozarella to 2 cups and the sour creams to 3/4 cup.  The crescent rolls did not "puff up" like I thought they would. All in all a quick dinner!! Served with seasoned green beans. Thanks

Made this for dinner and everyone loved it. I doubled the spaghetti sauce and mozarella sauce and used 3/4 cups sour cream. I also added some oregano and italian seasoning to the meat and sauce. This was a quick easy meal that will be used again. Thanks bamabelle.

Loved this!  The whole family made this together and we actually got my daughter to eat it.  She is a picky eater at this young age (5) so we are encouraging her to cook so she will try things.  She loved this!!  All of the ingredients go together so well and this is a very QUICK and EASY recipe.
Very Good!!!  Everyone really liked it.

It was quite good, I loved the parmesan cheese and butter on the top.  I think I would add some mushrooms and peppers to the ground beef mixture.
Thanks,

This was a great mid-week meal!  Added a salad and good to go.  I always seem to have a cup or so of leftover sauce when I make spaghetti (Recipe# 324856) and this was an ideal use for it.  I used 1-1/4 to 1-1/2 sauce as I thought 1 cup too skimpy.  Don't see how it would serve eight as written; would need to double it in my opinion.
This was a nice, simple meal to make and my family loved it.  I also added garlic and some seasonings to my ground beef, but otherwise did the recipe as written.  Thanks!  It's a keeper.
This was a really good easy recipe. I added twice as much sauce and sour cream cheese mixture. I think this is more like 4-6 servings with out the additional sauce. Super easy and good. Thanks!

Just made this for dinner tonight and it was so delcious!!  The recipe says it serves 8, but between my husband, myself, and our 3 year old, we ate almost the whole thing!  Everyone had seconds, which is sometimes rare with a somewhat picky little girl.  There will most definitely be a fit over the leftovers tomorrow.  Thanks for sharing this delicious and easy recipe!

Really good & cheesy :)
Thanks for posting

Yummy and nice and cheesy! This was just a nice easy cheesy dish that the whole family enjoyed. I think next time I might add some sliced green peppers. I will be making this often.  Thank you for posting.
Very good and EXTREMELY EASY!!!  Easy to throw together for a quick homecooked meal!

WOW! This is great stuff! I lightened the recipe up a bit and used ground turkey and low-fat cheeses, sour cream, and crescent rolls - and this STILL was a ZAAR STAR! DH absolutely loved it and is already asking for it again. I took the leftovers for a work lunch today and thought it was even yummier. Thanks for sharing -- will make this again & again!
Delicious! I used ground hot italian sausage and it was TO DIE for!

So so good!!! I did add garlic to the meat mix. I also added mac and shells to the dish (like the others did). To add a little more spice I also added pepper jack cheese. I used the butter cresents and added garlic butter on top of them with the parmesan. Will for sure be making this one again! We loved it!!

My son's LOVE this recipe.  It's always gone in no time, and its easy and inexpensive.  I have found that the crescent rolls have enough fat in them that I only need to dust the top with parmesan cheese, not mix it with butter.

This was very tasty.  My topping turned out just a touch doughy, even though it was in the full 20 minutes.  The top was starting to get a bit dark so I had to take it out.  Next time I'll lower the oven temp to 350 and bake it for 30 min.  Still very tasty and I'll definately make it again.

This has become one of my "go to" recipes. Casseroles do not go over well in our home, so this has been renamed "upside down pizza". Didn't fool my son, but his comment was, "Finally! A casserole I like." I like the versatility of this dish, not to mention the yummy factor. Thanks for posting. You've saved me more than once!
This was excellent, fast and easy. I added fresh mushroom and about an extra 1/2 cup of spaghetti sauce. My husband had two helpings. I cooked mine about 25 minutes.

Very tasty, and many of my family were coming back for second helpings! The only fault I found with this was that it turned out a little sweeter than I was expecting, but that may have been because we used canned sauce for it.
And one other issue was that the cheese mixture came up a little short, but thankfully I had some extra ingredients on hand.
Very tasty, and next time I'll try making it with a different sauce and see how that pans out.
Thanks for the recipe!

We tried this recipe tonight - like others, I was a bit worried about the sour cream thing but it came together wonderfully!  My fiance was also impressed.  I did substitute the Garlic and Butter crescent dough as someone else had suggested and it was awesome.

This came together quickly and was very good!  I lowered the heat (~350) and baked a little longer, to ensure the crescent rolls would not get too dark but would get thoroughly baked as well.  It was good for something different, and using ingredients I already had in the house.  :)

This was good. I used a 9x13 pan because that is the closest size to the one called for. I used more spaghetti sauce that called for since I felt it needed it. I also added 1/3 cup mayo to the cheese and sour cream and increased the sour cream. Both these additions made it more spreadable. Anyone who likes this recipe will also love my Deep Dish Taco Pie Recipe #151806. It is VERY similar to this, only the layering is a little different. Thanks for the post.
This wasn't my favorite but then again I didn't have shredded mozz so I used cubed.  Sure it made a difference.  Would definately use more sauce next time.

This was a nice casserole and very easy to put together. I made it as is but added a little extra sour cream to make it more spreadable. I think next time the only change I will make is using spaghetti sauce with lots of chunky vegetables inside. That will add some sustenance to the meal instead of mainly meat. Thanks for posting!

This was so easy and sooo good!
My kids really loved it!
Thanks so much for posting!

Fantastic!  This was quick to put together and everyone went back for seconds.  I used low-fat versions of most things (lean beef, reduced fat mozzarella, 2% milk sour cream, reduced fat crescent rolls) and it was still rich and delicious.  Based on other reviews I added a little bit of green and red bell pepper and I used a chunky vegetable pasta sauce to get all the food groups in.  I will definitely be making this again in the near future!
Great quick dinner! Kids loved it! I will be making again!! Thanks!

Great and easy! Used ground turkey, seasoned with onion, garlic, salt, pepper, and grated baby carrots, lowfat mozarella, light sour cream, and lowfat crescents - still was fantastic!  I melted the butter and mixed in the garlic powder, then brushed it over top. I am calling it crasagna cause it's like lasagna with crescents instead of pasta!  Very picky DH gave it 5 stars, he had 2 helpings, and took 2 for lunch today.  I will definitely make this again - thanks for sharing!

This was great and super easy to make! I followed the recipe exactly. The only thing I would change is to not mix the butter and parmesan cheese together since the cheese tasted kind of gritty. And I'd probably use a slightly smaller pan since the 9x13 was too big (don't have an 8x12). Maybe I'll try it with a 9x9. The kids loved it and want me to make it again!

This was sooooooo good and really easy to get on the table in a short time.  I was surprised at how tasty it was and I did not have to change a thing.  I used a Tuscan-Style Olive and Garlic spaghetti sauce so that may have been all the extra seasoning it needed, IF it needed any.  Was excellent, I pigged out completely and hubby went back for 2nds as well. Going on my regular rotation so Thanks, I always love regular rotation recipes.
So delicious -- my boyfriend and I renamed it "Upside Down Pizza Casserole." I will be making this again for sure. Thank you!!!

We couldn't figure out what to call this, a pizzagna or a lapizza! It's kind of a mixture of a pizza and lasagna, but not really. 
I will tell you that the mozzarella and sour cream filling is awesome and the recipe is super easy with minimal ingredients. We spent the day working our community's yard sale and were beat, but didn't want to just grab some fast food. This recipe made a nice, hot meal that was delicious, in a very short time. The flavors aren't over powering, so it will appeal to just about any picky eater.

I was skeptical at first because this recipe seemed just too simple, but WOW! My husband inhaled two rather large helpings, and there were NO leftovers. This was quick, easy and inexpensive to make. Thanks so much!
Sorry, but this recipe did not deliver.  When I asked my family, they said this would not be something they would ask for again.
My family raves about this recipe every time I make it. I do add a little Italian seasoning and garlic powder while cooking the meat. Easy to make and easy on the budget too!
It was quick, easy and delicious!  My family loved it!  I think next time I will cut up some italian sausage to make it hardier because my guys love meat!  Great meal!  Thanks

This recipe was fast, easy and DELICIOUS!  Didn't have a full lb of ground beef so just added lots of extra veggies since we love them so much.  Cooked garlic, green and yellow pepper, asparagus and extra onion all with the meat.  Also didn't have quite enough sour cream so for the rest I used a garlic artichoke cracker dip.  I seasoned every layer as I usually do in all my cooking.  I think I might attempt a vegetarian version next time as both my BF and I enjoyed the veggies more than the meat itself. Pretty versatile recipe!

YUM! I love this recipe! My Hubby and kids all went back for more.. So easy! I added all the spices I would if I was making spaghetti and added almost a full jar of my favorite spaghetti sauce (I used 2 lbs gr beef),chopped up some mushrooms and Green Pepper to add to the meat mixture and used Garlic & Butter flavored Crescent rolls. Curious to try a mozzarella/ricotta mixture next time. I will use this one again and again!
We enjoyed the buttery-ness of the crescent rolls with the beef mixture. Really tasty and super easy for a quick dinner after a long day of work.
Thanks so much!  I added more sauce as indicated in other posts and melted in about a handful of spinach.  My husband NEVER eats vegetables and said he liked it!  Banner day at our house!
This was so good and easy to make! Used marinara sauce and it tasted amazing! Only cooked for 18 minutes.
This is a new favorite for us!  The crescent rolls that I had on hand were garlic flavored and it worked out very well.  Couldn't believe how easy it was to make.

Wow is this ever easy!  I got home at 6:15, made this and was eating by 7:15.  This is good, however, I can see that the spaghetti sauce that you use needs to be very flavorful.  Mine was not.  I did add fresh mushrooms and next time I will add alot of spices to the ground beef mixture, as I felt it was a little bland (could be due to the sauce I used).  My husband asked if this was like an upside down pizza, and I agree it has that kind of flavor.  I will fix this again adding more spice and vegies, maybe olives and bell pepper.  But for ease this can't be beat.  Thank you for posting Bamabelle.
Great recipe! I added more sauce & garlic. Super easy and will definitely be sharing this recipe w/my friends. Thanks!
I make this exactly as posted and we really enjoyed it! Thanks for a great recipe for my "keep" file!

This was delicious! I used extra lean ground turkey breast, 1 1/2 cup reduced fat mozzarella cheese, light sour cream and reduced fat crescents to keep this healthy. Even with all the reduced fat ingredients, it was so delicious that even my picky fiancee had two helpings. Next time I make this, I may add some diced green peppers to the meat mixture, use a reduced fat Mexican cheese blend, and add rotel to the meat instead of spaghetti sauce. I think that would be delicious as well! Very versatile recipe and super easy, thanks for posting!

This came out amazing.  I followed directions exactly as stated and it was so easy to make.  My whole family loved it and the leftovers tasted just as good the next day.  I am making again tonight.  Thank you so much for posting recipe.

SUPER YUM, as rated by my husband. Disclaimer on changes: I used ground chicken instead of beef. Also, I added 1/2 cup ricotta and 1/2 cup spinach to the cheese mixture. Another thing I did which added to the appearance is I halved the recipe and made it in a pie dish.

This is delicious!  Hubby's been working late so thought I'd look for a casserole recipe to last us a couple of nights.  This one popped out at me and so glad I tried it.  I used an Arrabiatta (sp?) spaghetti sauce and added mushrooms & a little garlic (because that's just who I am).  We definitely have a keeper and it's easy, too!

Excellent! This tastes great & is super easy! I had to make a few adjustments based on what we had. I used pizza dough rather than the crescent rolls & I also had to use ricotta cheese so I just added a few tablespoons of milk to get it a little thinner like sour cream. I used a jar of pizza sauce rather than the spaghetti sauce, only used a cup of the mozzarella, & added pepperoni to the filling and on top of the crust. I also spiced it up a little with some fresh basil, oregano, garlic, salt, pepper, etc. We had the leftovers tonight and we both agreed that it was even better than the first night, which we didn't think would be possible! Thank you so much for a winner on all counts!

It was ok. My son really liked it. It needed something to mix with all that meat and you had to all but burn the cressent rolls to make sure they were fully cooked underneath.  Its worth a try at least once to see if you like it but I doubt I will make it again.  I also added spinach to the meat mix.

Very good. I did change it up quite a bit but used the main recipe as a core. I added two fresh tomatoes, two cloves of minced garlic, 1/4 chopped green olives, and spinach to the sauce and seasoned with fresh oregano and garlic salt. Added asiago cheese to the topping
Kids loved so I have to give it 5 stars. There are not many dishes that they like but every single one of them said we needed to have this once a week. I loved it too.

This was so quick, easy and flavorful. Of course I doctored up the spaghetti sauce with beef boullion, basil, garlic, celery seed, vinegar. Sorry this will not accept any stars. I will have to imput that later.
This was ok.  It was quick and easy.
Very good recipe.  I made this and we really liked it.  Its a good base recipe and anything can be added with it.  Thank you for sharing with great recipe with us.

This was a great recipe. I followed the advice of other reviewers and seasoned the ground beef with garlic powder and seasoned salt while that and the onions (I used a whole, chopped onion) were cooking. I also used a bit more sour cream to get the cheese mixture to a consistency that I could spread. After seeing the main picture for the casserole, I also added pepperonis to the top before baking. It reminded me of a really wonderful pizza sloppy joe. It got great reviews across the board from our family. The only thing that was misleading was that this was described as "zesty" and I found nothing in the ingredients to create that zestiness. I wound up adding somewhere between 1/4 and 1/2 tsp of crushed red pepper flakes and it turned out great. Thanks for posting! It's a keeper!
This is simple and relatively quick to make! Definitely need to season up the meat for full flavor. Another perfect use for crescent rolls! YUM.
Great dish!  None left!  Will definitely be doing this again!  I've been looking for something similar to stuffed manicotti and this is pretty much it.  Not as expensive.
Tasty, quick recipe for an easy dinner.

This was OK, as written it wouldn't have enough flavor. I made as directed with the exception of using pizza sauce and adding pepperoni. I presented it to my kids as "upside down pizza". I added garlic powder and oregano to the topping (melted the butter before brushing on top) and a lot of seasoning to both the meat and the cheese. It was good, but not over the top amazing that I would anticipate based on the reviews. It is a quick meal when you only have a few things on hand, but they were not ready for a repeat. Thanks for sharing, it's always a challenge finding a recipe that everyone, including the kids enjoy!
love it!!!!
Of course this is great! I loved it when you first made it for me 33 years ago.  All my family enjoys this recipe.  Thanks dear friend!  Elaine

This was very excellent, my family loved it.
I have already gave this recipe to a friend.
It is fast and easy to make, short cooking time and makes a great meal if you are in a hurry,
I added celery very thinly chopped and a cooked 2 carrot diced with the potato, to add color and taste to the dish. I used red potato keeptthe skin.

This is great.  I added a handful of chopped green peppers and some fresh mushrooms with the onions.  Also, after I started making this I discovered that there wasn't any milk, so I used frozen creamed corn instead of regular corn for creaminess and then added some of the water from cooking the potatos.  This is a wonderful dish and I have now made it twice this week to use up leftover ham.

What great additions you all have thought of to the soup! Actually, mystery girl, I use canned milk ( 1 1/4 Cup) so I can use the potato water too. So full of nutrients. Haven't tried any of your additions yet. We still love it plain and simple, fast and cheap. It is our comfort food all winter. LOL Thanks for all the comments. What a nice group of people you all are.  Ann

This is a wonderful so easy recipe to make, it was absolutly delicious. My husband raved about it, and how good it would taste with shrimp or chicken also. If you love chowder, you won't be disappointed !
excellent and easy too. i added carrots,celery, an 1/8 tsp of red pepper flakes, fresh parsley, and chives. good chowder
This was good and very easy!  Makes a great weeknight meal using leftover ham.  I added green onions and shredded cheese to each bowl before serving.  Thanks for the recipe!

This Chowder was just great!  It was extremely quick and simple to make and I followed the recipe pretty much, but added some grated carrot.  I used leftover cottage roll, (minced) it in my food processor.  I have shared this recipe with several friends.
Wonderful soup! Great tasting and easy to make!This is the kind of recipe that makes me LOVE Recipezaar!  Thanks for sharing!

We have made this soup 3 times now, once with ham and twice with chicken. The second time we used 2 cans of soup and the last time I used the cream style corn, which made the soup thicker. My family loves it and thanks you for sharing the recipe!

ditto everyone else's positive comments. this soup was simple and perfect. i used about a cup of half n half instead of milk to make it creamier and added some grated carrot and cheddar. everyone should try this chowder, it's that good.

Had some leftover ham and potatoes from Easter so I thought this would be a great recipe to try.  It was definitely the right choice!  After reading the other reviews, I used a can of creamed corn, canned milk, a little chopped celery and added two slices of American cheese. The results were really terrific!  Very creamy and rich.  So easy!
My favorite kind of recipe,easy quick,filling and yummy!We enjoyed it very much just as written,and it is nice to know I can play with it and add other ingredients without ruining the recipe!

A "must have" for leftover ham!
Deliciuos!  I used a little less milk so it would be thicker and added some cheese and scallions before serving.
This stuff was good and easy to prepare...I used only 2 cups of milk...I like chowder a little thicker...If I make it again, I will cut the milk back even more...Thanks for a good meal...
Delicious,fast, and very easy to prepare.  We all enjoyed this very creamy soup that made excellent use of leftover ingredients (holiday ham, corn, potatoes etc).  I didn't change a thing. Thanks!
I tried this recipe with my leftover ham from Christmas. It was very quick and easy to make. I added peppers and carrots. My family enjoyed it very much!

This was a different and tasty way to use up some of that leftover ham from Christmas.  My husband loved it.  The children liked it too.  It is hard for me to find something that everyone in the house likes, but this did it.  It was very creamy and so easy to put together!  Thanks for the great new soup.
A delightful winter soup!  We ate it twice in one day!  Added some cheese to top it off.

For ease of preparation and cleanup, I microwaved the potatoes, then quartered them and added to the chowder.  It turned out great.  Very flavorful.  For dinner, all I needed was a small bowl of this and a glass of Diet Coke!

Excellent! Instead of the cooked potatoes, I used 3/4 cup of instant potato flakes. I like my chowders thicker, and this made it nicely thick. I also used 2 cups of ham because I am a 250lb meat eater. The amount of pepper I used was 1/2 teaspoon. My wife thought it was a little too hot, but I thought it was just right. Thanks for the keeper.

Have you ever observed 3 teenagers and a grown man trying to lick their bowl? This is wonderful: great flavor, texture,simple to make!. I normally follow the recipe exactly however, today I was trying empty the fridge and added 3/4 cup cooked floweerets from cauliflower, 1 1/2 ounce of cream cheese and 1/3 cup of sour cream at the end just melting the cheese and blending in the sour cream. WOW!! Thanks Ann for sharing this great recipe!!

This is so good! I had to change some things though: we didn't have any potatoes, so I left them out (which was just fine!) While cooking the onion (no butter) I also cooked some green pepper. For the ham, I used julienned ham strips (they came that way!). Also, I only used 2 cups of milk (next time I'll use less). I added a dash of crushed red pepper flakes as well. (I followed a lot of people's suggestions!) It turned out delicious! Thanks for posting!

My family loved this recipe!  I had leftover ham from Easter and I am not a huge ham fan, so I thought I would try to make something with the leftovers.  We decided on this recipe.  It was wonderful.  I did use cream of celery since I am allergic to mushrooms and I used 1/2 cup cream and 2 cups milk.  Other than that, I stuck to the recipe.  It was creamy and very tasty.  We will be making this again.  Thanks for a great recipe!

Very simple soup but tasty.  I cooked the potato in the soup. I added a little arrow root to thicken and a little bit of thyme.  Topped it with bacon bits and sharp cheddar. Oh, I did use cream corn instead of regular corn, as was suggested.  

If you want to cut the calories, I made this with skim milk (2c)and reduced fat cream of mushroom.  The ham I used was Healthy Choice from the deli, cut off in one thick slice.  They only had the sweet ham and I wanted smoked but I was afraid the salt would be too much.

This was a wonderfully quick & tasty chowder. My husband really enjoys chowders, but he likes them chalked full, so I doubled the ham & the potatoes, while leaving the other ingredients the same. We really enjoyed this.  I did make some minor changes, similar to the ones others have made.  I decided to try cream of asparagus soup instead.  I also only had cream corn, so I used that.  I then only used 2 cups of milk.  This is truely a versitile recipe.

I thought this was wonderful!  I did use fresh potatoes and just added them to the soup.  It was great!  I also put a little cheese on top.  So yummy!  This one is a keeper!
Thansk!

Great use for leftover ham.  Delicious, simple, quick.....I used a can of cream corn and used some chicken broth to cook my potatoes in...No further addition of milk was necessary.  This was a perfect Saturday night dinner...Thanks for a great recipe!!!
I made this for my family, and friends, and they raved about it. Very easy to make, and tastes great. Thanks for sharing.

I loved this recipe, giving it 4 stars because I added some extras.  first I used one whole sweet onion, left out the potatoes, added more corn and ham, used 2 cans of mushroom soup.  I wanted it thicker so I added a little heavy cream, seasoned with garlic powder, salt, pepper and Tony's Creole.  Also added about 1 T of cream cheese and a touch of sugar to even out the flavors.  I sent a bowl to my husband's grandmother who is in the hospital right now and she raved about it.  Thanks for a great base recipe that is forgiving when you play around with the ingredients.  I will make this again.
I loved how easy this was! very yummy. Used creamed corn and added some bell pepper. Thanks for posting.
I LOVE  this chowder!  It is so quick, easy and delicious.  Made with left-over ham, it's very economical as well.  Everyone loved this.  Thanks Ann, for a great way to use up left-over ham.
Made this for the first time last night....it was awesome!!  I brought it to work today and gave some to my friend and she LOVED it!!!  It was easy to make!!! Worth making again!!
Wonderful! We really enjoyed this. Another family favourite.

Made this last night. Absolutely wonderful! Used extra taters, and ham, and milk (I wanted more then just four servings), also, added a couple of good shakes cayenne pepper for a little zing. Grated come gruyere over the top of my steaming bowl and had with two pieces of some really good garden vegetable wheat toast. Perfect!
Very easy to prepare and delicious.  What a wonderful way to use leftover ham and potatoes.  Thanks for posting!
This was very goo. My husband and daughter loved it, no leftovers to speak of.
Just like my mom made. A little too milky. Next time I'll add more potatoes. Comfort food.

I was searching for soups,stews and chowders to use up my left over ham ( on bone) and I am going to try this one.  There are alot of eye catching recipes, but I have all this on hand. A great way to use up the last of that bag of potatoes and use some of that home grown frozen corn I worked so hard on ! I will use the advice on the milk, and add it a little at a time for preferred consistancy.  I am boiling the ham off the bone so there will be some natural ham broth in my chowder.  I'll post for other viewers.  THanKs !
This was a quick and easy comfort food recipe.  It was very flavorful.  Will be making again. Followed the recipe exactly and see no need to make any changes.  Thanks for posting it.
A very good soup and a great way to use leftover ham.  I used only 1/4 cup of onions (personal preference)...otherwise I followed the recipe as posted.  A comforting soup!

I made this last night on a cold winter eve, after a day of Christmas shopping, putting up the Christmas tree, and drinking eggnog.  It was perfect for this occasion - a warm, hearty, comforting chowder, that was a breeze to put together, and tasted delicious!  I made this, just as directed, with some added spices and a few dashes of hot sauce.  Wonderful, easy, homemade-tasting chowder - Mmmmmm!

The husband gobbled it up and went back for seconds...that RARELY happens!  Even the 6 year old took a few bites w/o dying. I followed Mystery Girl and added 1 can of cream of corn in place of drained corn and only 1 cup of milk. YUM.

My DH says this is his favorite soup now.  I put my potatoes in raw as someone else had mentioned, and just let the potatoes cook with the soup.  I put it all together and let it cook on low for about an hour.  Great way to use leftover ham.  Thanks for sharing such a wonderful family recipe :)

What a lovely soup!  I had no corn (whoops!), so I subbed frozen peas.  Like other reviewers, I've put the potatoes in raw and let them cook for an hour.  I also has some leftover celery and cauliflower that needed to  be used up, so they were tossed in.  Great meal!   I think I may add some paprika next time.  Thanks so much!

-Mrs. Dash original seasoning
-1 can 14.5 oz Italian diced tomatoes
-1 medium eggplant, cut in quarters
-1/4 cup water
I added Mrs. Dash on both sides of each chicken thigh, then added half the canned tomatoes on top of the chicken and some water and let that cook for 15 min under med. high heat.  Then I added the eggplant and added the rest of the canned tomatoes on top and cooked for another 10-15 minutes.  If you want, you can let it simmer for a little longer after this is all done.  The more it sits in these ingredients, the more flavorful.  This was a great modification, gave it more of a Mediterranean taste.  I guarantee you'll like it!

The marinade was very good, but a little mustard-y for my taste. My husband loved it though. We grilled it, and the exterior became a little crispy - delicious!

This marinade is fantastic and so easy to make. I have everything on hand (I just used bottled lime and lemon juice, and it turned out fine). I marinated chicken tenderloins overnight (about 19 hours, total) and fried them off in a pan on the stovetop. I served them over a salad for a light dinner and it was delicious. I used dijon mustard instead of coarse grain (because it sounded good) and mixed everything up in a gallon size zipper bag (because I'm lazy and didn't want to wash another bowl. I cna't wait to try this out on the grill--I'm sure it will be even better!

Made this as written except for the mustard, my husband is not a fan so I omitted it.  Otherwise followed the recipe.  I only marinated the chicken for 6 hours and it was still so delicous.  Can't wait to see how good it is after an over night marinade.  I made 12 drumsticks and baked them on a cookie sheet with parchment paper on the lowest rack position in the oven at 400 degrees and cooked for approx. 20 - 23 min. flipping the drumsticks over once 1/2 way through cooking.  Moist and full of flavor, thank you for a great marinade.

I was looking for a new marinade recipe and this is it!  Changed it a little, used spicy brown mustard (I liked the flavor), and only used lime juice (out of lemon) and added a little more brown sugar and used garlic paste (in a tube) instead of fresh.  The chicken thighs I used were amazingly juicy.  An easy recipe for a fantastic result.

This recipe was absolutely fantastic. As many have said before, it really doesn't need another 5-star rating, but I felt I'd also throw my 2-cents in. Not being one for chicken breast, but dieting, I needed something to make this chicken much better than the dry white meat it is. I didn't have the required type of mustard that the recipe called for, so I used French's yellow mustard, like others suggested. I also had no lime juice, so 3 tablespoons of lemon juice was what I used for the citrus. I only marinated it for 8 hours and cooked it on the grill. It came out juicy, flavorful, and delicious. DH also loved it, eating the entire chicken breast in just a few minutes, even burning his tongue slightly in the process (whoops!). This marinade lived up to it's name, even with substitutes! Wow. Simple. I will be making this recipe again!

This was really really good! It was a little sweet but w/a mustard kick-only marinated 7 hours or so, i will definitely try in overnight! Easy, delicious! My boyfriend liked it, too! I served it w/couscous and broiled asparagus w/a mustard cream sauce. YUM!!!

I love this marinade!  Easy to prep and great, tangy flavor!  I didn't use any fresh ingredients- they always expire before I get a chance to finish using them...but even with garlic powder and bottled lemon and lime juice, it still tastes awesome!  I also baked the chicken instead of grilled it...still great!

This is a VERY good chicken marinade.  I used it on bone in breasts and cooked for about an hour.  Simple to make and the whole family loved the flavor and the breasts were nice and juicy.  I liked how the skin roasted to a nice golden color....and the slightly sweet taste from the brown sugar was so good with all the other ingredients.  Cold leftovers were great also!  Thank you for posting this great, easy recipe!

Awesome marinade! I marinated for maybe 36hrs. The breasts came out so juicy and full of flavor! I used dijon mustard and brown sugar but kept everything the same. Next time, I'll try using honey in place of the sugar just to make it healthier. Thanks!
I thought this recipe was fine.  I had cut down the sugar and oil a little, and it still tasted good.
I loved the flavor of my chicken, it was extremely moist and delicious.  I cooked my bone-in leg quarters for 45min at 425 since I don't have a grill. Will surely make again, thanks!

This marinade was so easy and made our chicken delicious. I did not have time to let it marinate long, but I did use the Food Saver vacuum Quick Marinator, and it tasted great after marinating for only 2 hours.

I've been making this chicken for a couple years now, it's one of our regular marinades used for BBQ chicken. I use a whole grain mustard or dijon, whatever we have in the fridge. Instead of fresh lemon/lime juice, I use both from concentrate and just add a couple splashes in. I've tried different marinating times and it's best if it's left overnight. My DH loves it so much that we've nicknamed it fantabulous chicken in our house.
Absolutely excellent!  I follow the recipe as stated and used boneless skinless chicken thighs.  I only marinated 2 hours and still was most excellent!  Will definitely make this again.
Loved it! Used garlic powder and poured it into a gallon bag with 2 leg quarters and 2 skinless breasts. Yummo!
Very good, will make this again.  Thanks!

Delicious! I wouldn`t marinate for less than 24 hours though, as the flavours are still a bit subtle. The only change I made was to reduce the amount of mustard by a third. I don`t like dijon mustard so I was surprised to find I loved the marinade! Next time, I will marinate it a day and a half.

Aptly named - it is truly an amazing marinade!  This is now my one and only - amazingly tender and flavorful chicken - and I agree, fabulous cold too so great to take on a picnic.  Even my husband who doesn't normally care for chicken says it's great. I substituted molasses for the brown sugar once and it may have been even tastier. Thank you for sharing!
What a great marinade this is!  Gives lots of flavor to the chicken and we really enjoyed it cooked on the grill.  Will use this often, especially during the summer months!

This was really good but fell a little short on delivery.  I think we were expecting a flavor explosion that never really came.  I marinated B/S Breasts overnight and grilled them.  The chicken was tender and juicy, just not as flavorful as we had hoped.

We really enjoyed this.  Was worried at first as I thought cider vinegar stronger than normal white vinegar.  I used yellow mustard and garlic powder in place of cloves.  Was Delicious and will use often. Thanks.

Good marinade. Husband said it reminded him a bit of teriyaki (probably due to the sweetness from the brown sugar & cider vinegar). I marinated mine for only an hour and didn't have the lime...which is a bummer...I'm sure it would have been even better with the lime. This was still good. Oh, added a bit or dried rosemary.

Delicious!  I halved the recipe for 2 chicken breasts.. I didn't have a fresh lemon and lime, but I used 3 tbsp bottled lemon juice (for half the recipe) and it was perfect.  I marinaded it for about 3 hours, part of the time the breasts were still partially frozen.. worked great but next time I'll try to do it the night before!

DH loves chicken....I've never been a big fan, until now.  This recipe is amazing.  Followed the recipe (for a change), marinaded overnite, cooked on med grill.  The result was very flavorful and moist.  My chicken wraps will never be bland again!  Thanks for a great recipe, that uses ingredients I always have on hand.

The grilled chicken that results from this marinade is great. However, I ALSO loved the leftover, grilled chicken COLD too, for making AMAZING cold chicken sandwiches. The chicken is also delightful - cut into strips - and served over salad greens, [I posted my salad photo].

Wow! I really loved this! I made it as a OAMC trial as I'd seen another review. Worked perfectly. I put all the ingredients in the bag, added the chicken, mushed it around a little and then popped it in the freezer. Took it out 2 weeks later and let it defrost in the fridge. Cooked it in the oven and it was perfect!
Very simple and very delicious!
Excellent recipe.  I used 1/4c brown sugar only as we prefer a bit less sweet and it turned out perfectly for us.  Thanks for a great marinade recipe!

Lucky Me! I came across this recipe looking to try something new and just happened to have all the ingredients on hand. I had enough time to throw it all together before work and it marinated about 12 hours. Grilled it up and served it with a fresh green salad . . . . . . Wow! So yummy! Thank you for posting. I am a working mom of a two year old and meals that are easy, fast, and delicious are like treasures. The chicken was was juicy, flavorful, and tender. I was proud to serve it to my family, and you made it sooooo easy.

This was a big hit at my family bbq.  Got great reviews ont his even from the picky eaters.  I have shared the recipe with some of the guest.  I will definitely be making it again, it was very easy to make.
Good!  Did it's job to make tender meat, and was yummy, but I was left thinking it needed some herbs or something...
I was pleasantly surprised. This was very very tasty I followed directions exactly and my chicken breasts were moist and the taste was sooo good.

This is the only way to eat chicken.  After grocery shopping; I make the marinade, add the chicken and store in a a gallon ziplock bag and put in the freezer.  Makes dinner a breeze any day of the week. I've stored chicken up to 2 months, and did not have any issues.

Like many others, I cringe when the word "amazing" is used, but tried this recipe in spite of that.  I did not have any grainy mustard and subbed dijon, but otherwise followed the recipe as written and grilled over charcoal. This marinade produces some very tender and tasty chicken. The lime flavor is perfect. The second time (in a week) I made extra marinade for brushing on while grilling. The third time, (which will be soon) I,m going to try reducing and thickening some marinade for a sauce.

Yummy!!... Instead of a 1/2 cup of brown sugar I put a 1/4 cup of honey (plus one extra spoonful), a whole instead of a half squeezed lemon, and I nearly doubled the garlic and it turned out fantastic!  I marinated the chicken breasts for about 7 hours and then broiled them and they turned out great!  My boyfriend loved them!
This was good, just found that the flavour was fairly mild even after marinating overnight.
I really liked the flavor of this.  The only change I made was exchanging honey for brown sugar.  I let it marinade a good three or four hours.
Good, not extraordinary. I didn't think the long marinating made much difference. Served with bbq sauce, and used leftover chicken in a salad.
Great marinade! Flavor is good but no overpowering! I increased the garlic by a hair but other than that followed the recipe! Thx!
Wonderful!!
Loved this marinade.  We used boneless, skinless, thighs.  Defiinitely will be making this again.   Made for Name that Ingredient.

A good, basic marinade for grilling chicken, reminiscent of the American Legion barbecued chicken I had every summer as a kid. We had pretty large leg quarters, and knew it would take longer, lower heat to cook them, so we cut the sugar in half so it wouldn't burn. Also, my husband thought "whole grain" mustard meant ground mustard seeds, but thankfully he he put in only 1 1/2 tablespoons of ground mustard seeds instead of prepared mustard. Very tasty!

Wonderful chicken recipe that I've used for years.  Originally grilled at our annual 4th of July party and little ones through adults loved it.  Moist, flavorful, seasoned, but "still tastes like chicken."  Didn't make it the next year, and everyone was disappointed, so this is now our "traditional" recipe for chicken.  <br/>I've marinated for anywhere from half hour to overnight and results are all great.  For fajitas, I add cumin and chili flakes or powder to the marinade.

Amazeballs. My boyfriend, who normally only eats chicken because I make it has already begged me to make this again... and that's after 2 bites. I'm lazy and forgetful... so I let this marinate for I'd guess 36 hours before grilling it up tonight. It's perfect, moist, delicious, and incredibly tasty. This might end up in my weekly rotation now that it's almost grilling weather again. Trust me, you HAVE to make this.

The name says it all; this is AMAZING!  Made as written and marinated b/s chicken breasts for 10 hours and then grilled.  It is the perfect balance of sweet and tang!  DH loves grilled chicken but ooh'd and ahh'd throughout the entire meal.  Going into my Best of 2014 Cookbook.  Made for Name that Ingredient Tag.

I thought I'd reviewed this delightful marinade before, guess not. I have many recipes on file but this may be my favorite! In fact my hubby makes so much fun of me when I eat chicken marinated with this recipe, because of all the oohs and aahs I make, as I cut and eat tender slices; never bothering to sit down... it tastes that good. Honest it really does. The only addition I add is (homemade candied ginger root), which makes it absolutely MORE AMAZING! See: http://www.foodnetwork.com/recipes/alton-brown/candied-ginger-recipe.html
Amazing, delicious, and easy. Can use this chicken in any recipe or just plain! And I NEVER write reviews!

Looking for a low salt, low carb marinade for grilled chicken, I did the following.  Cut the sugar in half, eliminated the salt, used 1/4 lite soy instead of 1/2 cup.  Marinade was perfectly balanced, low in both salt and carbs.  I covered 3 chicken leg quarters and three breasts.  Next time I'll double the recipe.  Be sure to put the garlic through the garlic press so it will not burn on the grill.  Delicious.

Excellent!  Made just as directed, however we only marinaded for three hours.  We also grilled on a lower heat, which resulted in nice moist chicken, and an excellent glaze on the outside.  Will definitely make again often!

Quite delicious and moist!  It turned out to be a beautiful day to be at the grill this evening.  I panicked because I had not defrosted the chicken.  Anyway, fast forward, I whisked my ingridients as stated (used dijon mustard) and marinated the chicken for only 2 1/2-3 hours.  Sent my husband to the grill.  He came back.  My sister, my husband, and I raved how flavorful and moist the chicken was - esp. the skin! What a keeper!
Turned my bland grilled chicken into a star dish full of flavour

Amazing recipe, easy to make, and most all things everyone probably has on hand... i substituted the whole grain.. for a spicy mustard, which still turned out fantastic and the family loved it! marinaded it over night and turned out delicious.. very complex flavor for a very simple recipe! i suggest everyone to make this!!

Came out tangy but not to sweet and very tasty!  This is a crowd pleaser and really easy to make ahead.  I highly recommend for those that are bored of the same old soy sauce, Worcestershire, olive oil and garlic combination.  This chicken is fantastic in a salad as well!

What a wonderful recipe for grilled chicken.  We did just grill the boneless breasts on the grill preheated to medium, only 5 or 6 minutes per side, keeping a close eye on it.  We sliced it thin and enjoyed it on a green salad, but it would be great on its own with sides  like rice, or on a bun for a sandwich.  I'm sure leftovers would be equally fine, but we had none leftover!

Recommend *NOT* marinating overnight. The chicken became tough, dry and very lime-flavored in our case, though I do cut into cubes for grilling on a skewer. The cubes were quite good when we either 
  1) marinated for just an hour or two, or 
  2) wrapped up immediately and froze  until we were ready to defrost and grill. 

Other than those words of caution this recipe is easy and yummy, my daughter's favorite. And I use French's yellow mustard.

This marinade was very good.  I like others didnt' have all the ingredients so I substituted, I used wht.vinegar , lime and lemon concentrate, garlic powder and reg. mustard. It still turned out really, really good. Thank you!
Used chicken leg meat (boneless) and it was amazing! This marinade was an absolute success and I will definitely use it again.
Horrible.  Causes a sudden bout of force eating.  Must with the nearest any kind sauce to make edible.

This is my go to for all and any grilled breasts moist and tender....Cooked on Weber grill using indirect heat from the sides with chicken in the middle with drip pan nothing it. Kept grill temp between 400-425 degrees for a fast cook. 6-8oz breasts 20 min per side... DELISH...NEEDS ANOTHER 5 STARS ....thank you.P.S. use a submersible blinder and make it a tasty salad dressing also.

Love this recipe. Ive even left it o/n and grilled next day.....amazing. only changes....2 peeled (instead of apple cider vinegar)and shredded apples and dijon mustard(instead of ground mustard). Awesome on kabobs....marinate all.
Bought whole-grain mustard just for this marinade - it is well worth it - as is marinating overnight. You gotta try this!

I know I'm the bad one here, but I didn't care much for this recipe. I marinaded the chicken overnight per instructions and grilled the chicken on the pit. Anytime you use sugar in a marinade you have to be careful because the sugar can and will burn easily. I didn't have any issues with this, but you need to watch your chicken. Taste? Well....there was no flavor from the marinade inside the chicken. I've had just as good results (if not better) soaking the chicken in simple Italian dressing with some added spices. Unfortunately, this recipe won't be going into my recipe box.
This was very good. I only wish I had let it marinate longer to get more of the flavor. That was my fault, though. It could have used the whole 12 hrs.
We love this marinade. Chicken is always tender and a great flavour.
The mix of sugar, mustard, vinegar, and citrus just mixed too many flavors together. I ended up throwing the chicken away. Pass
I made this for my very picky husband. I used Dijon mustard and added seasoning salt. It was delicious!

We'll see. I'm giving it 3 stars for being easy to make and pretty staple ingredients. I then put the chicken in a vacuum sealer bag and sealed it. It's now in the freezer waiting a meal in the future. I will update when it is cooked and eaten. Made it a couple months ago, since everyone is so concerned about it. My husband and I both thought it was pretty bland. I hoped it would have been better based on reviews, but it wasn't our taste.

Oh. My. Goodness. This was so delicious, and so easy to make!!! I wasn't really prepared going in, so I used lemon and lime juice instead of fresh, and red wine vinegar instead of apple cider. I marinaded overnight and this was the most flavorful chicken I've ever had! This is my new go-to!

I don't usually waste time rating a marinade. But, this one deserves praise. I highly recommend this recipe. The chicken came out great. I didn't have any limes, so I used orange juice instead. Marinated for about 30 hours. It came out perfect.

This marinade was bomb! I had read a few reviews saying that there wasn't much flavor but I didn't feel that way at all! I thought there was the perfect amount of flavor. Not too overpowering, just perfect. I did make a couple of substitutions since I didn't have all the ingredients at hand. I used Dijon mustard instead of whole grain and I used naranja agria (sour orange) instead of lemon. It was fantastic. I've eaten it on salads and with veggies on the side. Goes so well with anything. Definitely my new go to marinade ;) thank you!
Easy to whip up, most ingredients were already on hand. ( I added sesimy seeds and a pinch of rosemary. ) but it was delish! 5 stars all day. Thank you.

Deboned thighs, marinaded over night. Broiled on high. Quick and easy. Compliments from the SO. They were like, "What marinade is this? It's so flavorful." And I was like, "uh, it's 'The Amazing Chicken Marinade', obviously."
If you can not grill, than I would broil. Baking will tend to dry it out
This is my new go to marinade. My husband and son loved it!!! I marinated for just over 24hrs so tender and juicy! A-M-A-Z-I-N-G!!!! My husband just raved about it!
Excellent marinade! Chicken was so juicy and tender with absolute amazing flavor! My entire family loved it. Definitely our new favorite. Thank you for sharing!
Tasty chops! I added about 1/2 tsp of dried thyme leaves. Nice flavor. Thanks!
Very good, easy to do.  I served with scalloped potatoes.  Nice meal.
Don't make this for your family if you're trying to diet.  This is just excellent - lasted about 24 hours in my house.  The syrup I think makes it particularly moist and "lemony".

Where do I start! Let's see -The cake itself is nice and firm and has a lovely texture. I must admit I did not bake layers but baked it whole and cut it horizontally into 3 layers in a 9 inch 4 inch high floral cake pan. Could do this easily. THe syrup really makes the cake soft and lemony. The pineapple filling was great and I added some red cherries to it while it cooked. I used sweetened soya whipped cream so did not add sugar. We do not get sweetened flaked coconut so I followed a tip I found on the net and moistened 1.5 cups dessicated coconut with a little milk and added 2 tsps of castor sugar and left it for about 10 minutes. I frosted the cake with white icing and decorated it with white rosettes at the base and green leaves on top and the coconut pressed at the side made this cake look so spectacular that I was proud to gift it for my best friend's birthday. Seven of us polished it off in around 15 minutes. All that work gone in a jiffy. But the sated expressions on the faces around was such a huge payoff. Thanks Ev. You made me look good! Fortunately you gave me prior warning about the rave reviews so was not completely swamped. My friend said she could not decide if I was a more fabulous person or cook :roll: and I borrow that line and use it on you. :D Fay

This recipe is wonderful!  While it does take more time than your average cake, this is definately NOT average.  If you are looking for a cake for a special occasion, this is it.  The cake is moist and the citrus flavor is subtle.  The filling is wonderful and just adds to the whole tropical taste.  As for the frosting ! how can you go wrong with flavored and sweetened whipped cream?  I made the recipe as directed, carefully following the directions.  Next time, I will make some of the parts the day before as suggested in the recipe.  Thank you so much for posting a keeper!

This cake performed above and beyond the call of duty for me.  After having done most of the preparation in advance as suggested, I was less than an hour away from having dinner guests come over and I was getting ready to assemble the cake - all that was left was the frosting.  I started to whip the cream, got distracted, walked away from the bowl and my hand mixer fell over taking the bowl with it and 3/4 of the cream spilled out on the counter, leaving me with half a cup of whipped cream to frost a 3 layer cake.  I had no time to go to the store and I was not about to give up on a cake I had put so much work into, so I added some softened butter I had on hand, a little half and half, some more powdered sugar and made a glaze out of it, put some of the pineapple filling on the top of the cake and drizzled the glaze between the layers and over the whole cake, topped off with some coconut.  It wouldn't have won any blue ribbons for appearance, but it did look like it was an intentional outcome and it tasted really good.  Next day we had a church/school barbecue and I crumbled up the half cake I had left over, layered it with whipped cream, lemon curd, coconut, almonds, pineapple and oranges and made kind of a left-over cake trifle.  No leftovers now!  The only bite I got was the taste I took to make sure it was ok.  I had to give this one five stars for holding up so well after a near disaster.

I made this today for my friends family birthday party.  Everyone gave it two thumbs up.  I will be making this for another family function tomorrow but will use and orange juice glaze with some rum in it instead of the lemon juice.  I didn't use a fresh pineapple but used crushed instead as I was too lazy to cut up a pineapple.  After covering it with coconut I arranged canned oranges on top with some mint leaves for a tropical display.

Thanks for posting this recipe.  My mom use to make it for us when I was in high school, she had gotten it from a well abused Bon Apetit magazine which I  misplaced. When I found this site with this recipe you could only imagine how happy I was. So I made it for her in a heart shape baking pan, as a thank you hence the little card beside the cake in the photo I shared.  We don't have lemons here in Belize but we do have limes so I used that instead and garnished it with a slice of fresh pineapple and lime zest flower. 

Thanks again for sharing this I am forever in debt.
This is a super easy and tasty side dish. Made this as a side to go with meatloaf and it was very good.
This was really good.  I made it with baked chicken and it went perfectly since I didn't have gravy.  These potatoes stand well alone without the gravy.  Yum!

Unbelievable!!! DELICIOUS X 10, Redsie!! Made in individual dishes to freeze some for later. YUUUUUUMMMMMMMMM! Must confess...made with real butter. I know (rollin' eyes)...more calories? but Oh!!!!! so, good!

5 stars for the fabulous taste.  I love the buttercrumb topping I guess best of all.  Of course Ritz crackers are always yummy and then mixed up w/garlic and butter...yummy!  I used redskins for my potatoes as that's what I had on hand.  Other than that, followed it word for word.  Thanks Red....another good one in my book(s):0
Good recipe.  The potatoes were creamy and the crumb topping was a great contrast.  They just needed some salt and pepper.  DH loved them.

Perfectly wonderful, cheesy  mashed potatoes!  Loved the crumb topping with the garlic flavor.  They looked fantastic coming out of the oven all toasty brown on top.  I did add a little extra milk and some salt and pepper when I mixed up the mashed potatoes!

I made a few changes to this recipe, I added in 1/4 cup butter, seasoned salt and fresh ground black pepper into the potato mixture, the cracker topping was a nice change from just regular mashed potatoes, thanks for sharing Reds, we enjoyed this!

This is a lovely potatoe dish. The potatoes were creamy, smooth and flavorful while the crunchy topping was a lovely contrast. I liked that the cheese didn't overpower the potatoes. I will make these again, thank you for posting.

I made this, a serving for two, with leftover mashed potatoes, that I heated up in the microwave.  I then added some extra milk, the cheese and the garlic powder.  I then mixed the melt butter with the crackers and topped the potatoes and then put in the oven to bake.  I was flipping between 4 and 5 stars,  as I am used to gravy with mashed potatoes so not as dry, but also like all the ingredients and the two different textures.  Next time I would add some seasoned salt and more butter, as Kittencal did for the potatoes!!  Thanks for posting Redsie.  Made for Stars Tag.

This was a big hit at my house. It is very much like this dish my husband and sons use to eat at a place in Grand Junction, Colo. the only thing missing was the green chili on it. Thanks for posting this recipe now I can make their favorite thing once in awhile.

Thanks SueL.
This is delicous!  It's very filling as well...I could barely get one down with some hash browns and fruit.  Yummy.  Definately comfort food.

Very Flavorful and extremely filling!! The only thing I did different was I added the sausage to the cream(slop) sauce, Sprinkled with paprika and chopped green onions. For bicuits baked Pillsbury Grands Buttermilk.

I used Jimmy Dean Bold Country sausage---this was a bit on the bold side, but still very good. Next time will use the regular. I cheated and used a McCormick Country gravy packet. Also used Pillbury Buttermilk Grands. It was a fast easy meal for dinner tonite, for my husband and myself. I am sure it will be even better with the homemade gravy version next time. My husband enjoys biscuits and gravy, so this will be a keeper for us. Thanks Sue L.
This is my husbands all time favorite breakfast.  When I make this for him, he thinks he's been very good to deserve getting it.  We love it.  Thanks

This is the first time I've called my family to the table and told them "Slops on the table"...lol.  Needless to say I got a few strange looks...hee hee.  We really liked this dish.  It was full of flavor and very good.  This is food that my family likes....total comfort food.  I will definately be making this many times over.  Thank you for this tasty and easy meal....Stephanie
Oh my gosh...this is so good! Comfort food to the max. We made it just as written. I think this one is will be appearing on our table at least once a month. Thanks for the recipe.

I looooved this.  I could have it everyday!  One of my fave breakfast food is biscuits & gravy so adding egg into it makes it superb.  My ds was the only one who didn't want it sloppy.  This is definately something I make when I have company staying the night.
This was GREAT!!! This is definetly comfort food!!! My wife raved about it and we will have this many more times. Thanks for posting!!!
FANTASTIC!!!!! I didnt change a thing. Used Tennessee Pride Mild Country Sausage and made the bisquits out of Bisquick Heart Smart Baking Mix. This is definately a keeper! Thanks so much for posting!
This was a very good recipe.  I had it for breakfast and had enough leftover for dinner so I added a layer of boiled root veggies into the sandwich and that was really good too.
looks good, but what's the nutrition value ? Especially carbohydrates and sodium ! We got to think health !!!!!

Wow! This was wonderful! It's so tasty and yet easy to make. I left the hot pepper sauce out for dietary reasons, but it was still great. I'll be making this again throughout the winter. Thanks, Inkling, for this recipe.
inkling, Wonderful, hearty, easy to make meal, thanks, Darlene
By golly, this is good soup!The pepper sauce adds a lot of zip. I used some left-over prime rib and left out the peas and potato (personal preference). Thanks for posting!!! Caroline

This was tasty, most of the family liked. The kids not so much, but you know how kids can be about veggies. Served with rolls, some family members put the rolls in the bowl before serving the soup. We added a cup of frozen beans also.

OMG!! This was the first time I've attempted to make Vegetable Beef soup so I was a bit intimidated.  This was so easy and so delicious!  I modified it a bit because I was lacking a few ingredients but it still came out wonderful.  The recipe made quite a bit; so I had leftovers and boy was I glad.  It was even better the next day.  I would completely recommend this recipe especially for the first timer soup maker.  Delish!!

This was my first time attempting to make a Vegetable Beef Soup, but this recipe made it so easy! And it was OMG delicious!!  I omitted the hot pepper sauce for personal preference and added a half can of tomato sauce; I also added extra potato and some cabbage, and it came out wonderful! Thanks for this great

So delicious on this cold, snowy day! I , too had to change up the recipe a bit. I had decided to make a bigger pot of soup so when I realized I only had 2 cans of tomatoes I substituted a 10 oz. can of Rotel for the 3rd can of tomatoes the 6-8 servings recipe called for and omitted the hot sauce. Also, our family prefers green beans over peas so I substituted 1 1/2 cup of those. I added a little bit of salt to taste, and mmm-mmm-GREAT!
Thanks for a wonderful Vegetable Beef Soup recipe ~ I doubt I'll ever use another.
Very good!!! Thanks for sharing!! I added cabbage!
This is a great vegetable beef soup. I really liked the little touch of spice from the hot sauce. I did add a pint of canned green beans. Thanks for the keeper.

this recipe is just ok.  i omitted the hot sauce which is very un-needed..  in place of the peas i added roughly chopped baby spinach leaves, barley, and i added homemade tortellini.   was amazing.   this recipe has quite a few flaws but it's a good starting point..
Finally!  I found the recipe i've been looking for.  Two small changes when i made it; used fresh garlic and instead of water used 4 cups v8 juice.  SO GOOD.  THANKS!
Very good soup recipe!  Very easy to put together and soooooooo tasty.  Love it and this is a definite do over.  Thanks so much for sharing!!!

Absolutely to die for! I doubled this recipe for my man-sized eaters and it was fabulous! I used left over prime rib meat and bones instead of stew meat. I also used hot sauce with lime in it because that's all I had. I slipped in a sweet potato (peeled) along with a regular (unpeeled) potato. I omitted the celery and put in some cabbage. It was excellent!! My family loved it!

A delicious and satisfying soup. I used "Rotel with green Chilis" in place of the canned tomatoes. The heat was 'over the top'!!  I wont be doing that again...unless maybe 1/2 can Rotel and 1/2 can tomatoes, because we like the heat. Thanks for a heartwarming recipe, Literary Mom!
First time making vegetable beef soup. Used 1 1/2 lbs beef tips and added green beans.<br/>I also simmered for five hours the flavor was amazing

I don't know what went wrong. I followed this recipe to the tee. It has no flavor whatsoever. I was concerned about all the water that was called for in addition to the beef broth, but I followed the recipe anyway. The picture of the soup doesn't look anything to the watery mess I ended up with. I don't know what I can do to save this and avoid wasting a huge amount of food. Gross!!

Enjoyed this soup for a fall weekend! Made some substitutions based on what was on hand. Used turkey sausage instead of beef and fresh green beans vs. peas. Also reduced water to 3/4 cup water vs. what's in recipe. Spiced it up with Cajun seasoning and hot sauce to taste. Really good!

My husband really likes vegetable soup and stew, but I don't. I've tried many different recipes over the years, but have never found one I've been willing to make again...until now. I have made this soup twice in two weeks! I mostly followed the directions, but after reading the reviews I did make a couple of alterations. I used fresh garlic in place of the garlic powder, V8 in place of the water, and added a cup of frozen green beans. Thanks for a recipe that my entire family loves!

This was my first ever attempt at homemade Beef Vegetable soup and it was delicious!! Absolutely full of flavour and good stuff! The beef was tender, the vegetables lovely and soft and the broth was packed with flavour too. There's nothing more comforting than a bowl of homemade soup and this is my new favourite!
Wonderful soup! Thank you!

I'm really just starting out cooking and learning the basics. Never really tried a soup before. Thissssss soup, was soooooooooo good tho! I followed the recipe to a T, only adding an extra can of tomatoes and green beans, was perfect! The only thing was the celery wasn't cooked down enough for my prefence. Delicious!

Cannot believe this Soup Recipe was so easy and Soo Good !!! Have tried before, but never can make good Broth, this Broth is Wonderful !!!! Being from the South, had to  add a bit of  Okra ... Thanks for the Recipe. S. Harper

Smells delish so far....I grilled a 2" thick top sirloin to an internal temp of 125 and cut it into bite size pieces. Then I seared it in a cast iron skillet and followed the directions from there. Was absolutely delicious.
Very unsatisfied with this recipe taste too watery spent 5 hours making this not sure what's missing but it's not like my mom's old fashion soup
This soup is FANTASTIC! I used V8 juice instead of water.

Excellent soup!! I substituted V8 for the water and threw everything (still raw) in the crock pot. Cooked on slow for 8 hrs and turned out so yummy! My 12 yr old could not get enough! Thank you for the great recipe!

I chose this recipe because my neighbor wanted a beef based soup and we were making her a meal! It seemed like an awful lot of water, so I left it out. When I tried it after 1.5 hrs on the stove, it was pretty bland, so I added a little salt, ground pepper and dried basil. After another hour the meat was tender and the flavor was excellent. We all enjoyed it, as did the friends we shared it with! Doubling this recipe made a large pot of soup (and that was without 8 cups of water!)

I've made this before, I didn't have any canned diced tomatoes , so I use 1 can of tomato paste, and cubed up a fresh tomato,also didn't have any hot sauce , so i use siracha ,came out magically delicious
Just received this recipe and yes I am going to make this this week. Getting chilly here in Wisconsin
Made this today and loved it. omitted the hot sauce and added a bit more of broth. delish. ty.

My mom made the best beef soup, this recipe taste's just like my mom''s it is the best and so easy to make. I substituted 28 ounces of stewed tomatoes, used 4 cups of water and omitted the beef broth to make it lower in sodium.

I've been looking for a good vegetable beef soup. It's always been one of my favorites since I was a child and ate Campbell's VB. I made it according to the directions, omitting the hot sauce originally. Then I got the idea to add barley so I took out all the potatoes and added the barley. I liked that even better. This soup was probably a 4 on the first day - but the second day - Oh, man. It was a 5 for sure. I'll be making this again.

This was amazing! I wasn't going to put in the pepper sauce then changed my mind. Took a taste after adding and thought you ruined it! It was awful! Then I told myself you have to let it cook. So I did... it was awesome, definitely a keeper. 5 star plus 2 thumbs up!

After reading the reviews and considering my personal preference, I decided to alter the recipe a wee bit. I used V8 juice instead of water ( I think that adding water to the recipe makes it a tad bit "watery" and it loses its consistency) and I also added an extra can of diced tomatoes. I seared the beef stew with olive oil, lemon pepper, and onion powder and proceeded to cook everything in a crockpot on high for 30 minutes and then turning it to low for about an hour and a half. The outcome was amazing so I gave it 5 stars because it is simple enough for anyone to make and the ingredients are spot on... Thank you for a thoughtless recipe for soup on this cold snowy day!
This was delish! Changes I made: left out water, peas and corn. I used fresh green beans, fresh garlic, added 2 Tbs. dried parsley and 1/2 Tsp. dried thyme.
Yes, I Dound it more thoughtful than thoughtless

Delicious! I used ground beef and browned the celery, onions and fresh garlic (instead of powder) before adding to everything else. I made a huge pot for 40 and a few even said it was the best vegetable beef soup they've ever had!
A keeper!
Delicious! Definitely making this again but I tweaked it a bit! Added green beans instead of peas, added a little oregano, parsley and old bay seasoning too!
Mmmmmm
Making for dinner on this cold evening in Lubbock, TX Pretty simple and smells great, reminds me of my MawMaws Beef Stew

I love soup and this was a very good recipe. I used fresh garlic, beef stock, low sodium v8 instead of water and no salt added stewed tomatoes. Loved the pepper sauce in this. Thanks for a great recipe!
Yes. I freeze it in wide mouth mason jars w/ plastic caps. Great to make a batch and keep on hand for lunches.
Just made this but we also tweaked it. My husband had a vegetable soup that was sweet so we added little brown sugar to our bowls of soup. It was great.
I love soup and excited too try this recipe
This is a delicious recipe. Thank you so much for sharing
Delicious comforting recipe! I absolutely love. Added elbow macaroni, with just carrots, peas and corn, and a dash of Worcestershire sauce. Absolutely amazing.
It is soooooo good!!! I added some salt & pepper & omitted the hot pepper sauce. Absolutely delicious!
This was the best vegetable soup I've ever had. I used fresh garlic instead of garlic powder and tomato juice instead of water. My husband loved it. This recipe is a keeper.

This soup actually annoyed me because it was so good. The simplicity of it made me kick myself for not coming up with it on my own. I used chicken broth, in place of beef broth and water, and I replaced the peas with barley. I think barley is a bit underused these days and it reminds me of my childhood and my mother. I used flour tortillas charred over a bare flame in place of crackers. Great meal.
Easy recipe & was so good!
Fabulous.....added celery as well great taste.....had a good ol peanut butter and jelly sandwich with my soup all that I can say is mmmm mmmm good!

Excellent. I added V8 juice instead of the water. I also used left over prime rib instead of cooking up some beef. I added barley, potato gnocci, parslety and some Italian seasoning and it was delicious.
Taste just as expected. My family loved it. My 10yr old asked for seconds and then the next day ate it for lunch. So comforting and fulfilling definity making again.
This soup turned out so well. I followed the recipe exactly, but I made my own beef broth from some leftover bones I froze, using this recipe https://www.tasteofhome.com/recipes/homemade-beef-broth
Amazing recipe and super easy to make. Honestly this is going to be my go soup. Thank you!
It was gooood a little spice that i was not use to,left a soup taste that's out of this wourld,i'll make the old fashion soup again,Thanks.

I made this exact soup and it was delicious! I tweaked it just a bit - I used chicken broth, started with a can of tomato soup, used diced chicken instead of beef, added a ton of Siracha sauce, added red peppers, diced garlic instead of powder, added grilled tomatillos, added black beans instead of peas, added some butter and heavy cream, plus a a few rusty nails! Was delicious! Thanks for posting this soup recipe!
I love this soup! Made it a few times now and used v8 instead of water every time. Very comforting and delish, especially when you have the flu!

I made a pot of Old-Fashioned Vegetable soup tonight using most of this recipe. I'm not sure what the 2 bay leaves added would taste like? I didn't have any ?? I don't care for corn or peas in any soup, so I put in green beans. My husband likes things on the hotter side - So - I kicked it up. Extra shakes of hot sauce *ok alot* I didn't realize the can of Rotel I was going to put in was the Extra Hot. Luckily I tested it before adding only 2 TBS. I put some shakes of Worsteshire sauce & a bit of Merlot. I let it simmer for a few hours & served it over cooked egg noodles. YUMMY ????

I have made this 3 times now; each time using green beans instead of peas and celery salt instead of celery stalks - I also forgot the hot sauce each time. I only used the diced tomatoes this last time. I have to say I prefer without the diced tomatoes. But it is a dish my whole family enjoys and super easy to make. We get WAY more than 4 servings out of this; I would venture to say at least 8. I made it yesterday, even with being sick and not wanting to be up, much less standing in the kitchen making dinner. It's that easy! The first go round, I sent some to my new mother-in-law and she absolutely loved it. My husband said this is his kind of meal. HOME RUN! Thanks for sharing!
I am kinda embarrassed, you see I followed the recipe as it is written. Didn't use V8 instead of water and I used celery stalks didn't change a thing. It turned out great! Thanks for the recipe

I used low sodium V-8 Juice instead of water. I also use powder meat tenderizer. I prefer green beans over peas too. It was perfect! Reminds me of home made soup Mom used to make! Thanks for your help.
I made this soup today. I substituted fajita steak for the stew meat and added bowtie noodles. The seasoned fajita meat gave it a great taste. Great recipe!
This was quite tasty and super easy to make, plus I had all the ingredients on hand. Thank you for sharing!
I found this soup recipe sometime ago and made it for my wife. I call it my best friend’s soup. She loves it Maria. It is a great way to get a vitamin filled meal that stays with you. Thanks, Craig
Recipe as written is great. Also very flexible, almost anything you have on hand can be added or adjusted for taste.
I made this for my family just a few adjustments and it was a treat. I will definitely be making this again so simple and better than any can soup!!

This recipe has become a favorite of mine and others in my house. I have made over 10x in crock pot (slow cooker on high for 4-6hours then on low for another few) and tweaked a little. The best it ever tasted is when I added a small pinch of Thyme and 1 cup chicken broth.

I fixed this soup last nite for dinner for the worlds 2 pickiest grand children, 8 and 9, and it went over very well. One didn't like the tomatoes, but loved the potatoes, additional veggies and meat, and the other loved it all. I did a few adjustments on the veggies. I added broccoli, green beans, left out the peas, and added cauliflower. It turned out much better than I thought and the adults loved it and want it again. So, thank you, I appreciate you sharing. Cheryl

Sara, I was perusing the newly posted recipes today, over my morning coffee, and I came across yours. I had the butter out in a flash and was making them an hour later. You're right they are the best. This recipe is so easy and with the glaze they look and taste like I really know how to bake! I divided the dough in half. The first half I followed the recipe exactly. The second half I added freshly grated nutmeg and omitted the glaze. Both were fantastic! Thank you for a great cookie recipe.

I made this recipe, doubled, this morning too, for my son's mother's day out class. It was loved by all, including the staff - I really enjoyed all the compliments!  I used oat flour, added nutmeg, allspice & ginger and threw in some coconut flakes & butterscotch chips.  I made half of the glaze for the cookies that stayed at home (didn't want things too sticky for the kids) - normally I top pumpkin cookies with cream cheese frosting - the glaze was a fabulous change.  Thanks!

Yum!
I had some left over pumpkin from making pumpkin bread and this was a perfect way to use it!  I had slightly less than a cup but it was fine.  I used half white flour, half wheat.  I only had light brown sugar but that worked fine too.  I did add a little bit of nutmeg as well.  Next time I might spoon or drizzle the icing.  I'm glad you mentioned the cake consistency otherwise I would have been concerned since they didn't spread out.
I'll post a picture of the outcome.
Thanks!
Absolutely the best!

These cookies are amazingly addictive - tender, moist, flavourful & a little different from the ordinary.  My only criticism is that the glaze makes them unbearably sweet.  We enjoyed them a lot more before they were frosted.
Wow! They are so soft and yummy!  More like little cakes than cookies. My mom and stepdad said they were some of the best cookies I have ever baked :)

Very yummy cookie, tastes like pumpkin pie, and I like the cake-y texture for a change.  I added just a touch of freshly grated nutmeg to the dry ingredients, and put a walnut half on top of the icing.  As one other reviewer mentioned, the glaze is VERY sweet (almost too sweet for me); next time I will try using a cream cheese frosting instead.
